          "Prompt": {
            "prompt": "You are acting as the Principal Software Engineer responsible for approving SpeedPlus for production launch.\n\nYour job is not to give a superficial code review. Perform a complete production readiness audit of the entire system.\n\nAssume this application will handle real customers, merchants, riders, payments, and operational data. Think like the engineer who will be on-call after launch and personally responsible for system failures.\n\nRepository:\nObeeJ/speedplus\n\nBranch:\ndev\n\nGoal:\nDetermine if SpeedPlus is truly production-ready.\n\nDo not assume anything works. Verify everything.\n\n==================================================\nAUDIT APPROACH\n==================================================\n\nFollow this order:\n\nPHASE 1 — SYSTEM UNDERSTANDING\n\nFirst inspect and document:\n\n- Repository structure\n- Frontend application(s)\n- Backend application(s)\n- Frameworks\n- Programming languages\n- Database\n- ORM/query layer\n- Authentication system\n- Authorization system\n- Payment integrations\n- Third-party services\n- Storage systems\n- Notification systems\n- Deployment configuration\n- Environment variables\n- CI/CD pipelines\n\nCreate a complete architecture map.\n\nExplain:\n- What each part does\n- How data flows\n- Where failures can happen\n- Whether the architecture can scale\n\n\n==================================================\nPHASE 2 — USER JOURNEY AUDIT\n==================================================\n\nAudit the application from the perspective of every user type.\n\nDo not only check happy paths.\n\nCheck:\n- Happy path\n- Failure scenarios\n- Edge cases\n- Invalid inputs\n- Network failures\n- Payment failures\n- Duplicate actions\n- Partial completion\n\n\nCUSTOMER FLOW:\n\nAudit:\n\n1. Landing/onboarding\n2. Account creation\n3. Login\n4. Verification\n5. Profile setup\n6. Address/location setup\n7. Service discovery\n8. Product/service selection\n9. Cart/order creation\n10. Checkout\n11. Payment\n12. Order confirmation\n13. Order tracking\n14. Cancellation\n15. Refund\n16. History\n17. Reviews\n18. Support\n\n\nFor every step answer:\n\n- Can the user complete this?\n- What happens if it fails?\n- Is the backend state correct?\n- Is the database state correct?\n- Is the UX clear?\n- Are users trapped?\n\n\n==================================================\nRIDER FLOW\n==================================================\n\nAudit:\n\n- Registration\n- KYC/verification\n- Approval\n- Availability status\n- Receiving jobs\n- Accepting jobs\n- Rejecting jobs\n- Navigation\n- Pickup\n- Delivery confirmation\n- Earnings\n- Withdrawal/payment\n\n\nCheck:\n\n- Can two riders accept one order?\n- Can riders manipulate statuses?\n- Can riders fake completion?\n- Is location tracking reliable?\n- Are earnings accurate?\n\n\n==================================================\nMERCHANT/VENDOR FLOW\n==================================================\n\nAudit:\n\n- Registration\n- Verification\n- Store setup\n- Inventory\n- Pricing\n- Order receiving\n- Accept/reject\n- Preparation\n- Settlement\n\n\nCheck:\n\n- Can merchants alter prices incorrectly?\n- Can inventory become inconsistent?\n- Can orders disappear?\n- Are settlements accurate?\n\n\n==================================================\nADMIN FLOW\n==================================================\n\nAudit:\n\n- Dashboard\n- User management\n- Rider management\n- Merchant approval\n- Refunds\n- Reports\n- Fraud prevention\n- Analytics\n\n\nCheck:\n\n- Are admin permissions secure?\n- Are sensitive actions protected?\n\n\n==================================================\nPHASE 3 — BACKEND PRINCIPAL ENGINEERING REVIEW\n==================================================\n\nReview every backend module.\n\nCheck:\n\nAPI DESIGN:\n\n- REST/GraphQL correctness\n- Naming\n- Versioning\n- Validation\n- Error handling\n- Status codes\n- Documentation\n\n\nBUSINESS LOGIC:\n\nAudit:\n\n- Order lifecycle\n- Pricing calculation\n- Delivery fees\n- Commission\n- Discounts\n- Promotions\n- Wallets\n- Payments\n- Refunds\n- Settlements\n\n\nFind:\n\n- Incorrect calculations\n- Missing validations\n- Race conditions\n- State inconsistencies\n\n\nDATABASE:\n\nReview:\n\n- Schema\n- Relationships\n- Constraints\n- Indexes\n- Queries\n- Migrations\n- Transactions\n\n\nLook for:\n\n- N+1 queries\n- Missing indexes\n- Duplicate data\n- Data corruption risks\n- Poor normalization\n\n\nCONCURRENCY:\n\nTest mentally:\n\n- Double payment\n- Double order creation\n- Double rider acceptance\n- Duplicate refunds\n- Inventory race conditions\n\n\n==================================================\nPHASE 4 — FRONTEND ENGINEERING REVIEW\n==================================================\n\nReview:\n\n- Component architecture\n- State management\n- API handling\n- Error handling\n- Loading states\n- Empty states\n- Forms\n- Validation\n- Responsiveness\n- Performance\n\n\nCheck:\n\n- Broken screens\n- Missing states\n- Bad UX flows\n- Poor feedback\n- Accessibility issues\n\n\n==================================================\nPHASE 5 — UI/UX PRODUCT DESIGN REVIEW\n==================================================\n\nJudge as a Senior Product Designer.\n\nReview:\n\n- First-time user experience\n- Visual hierarchy\n- Navigation\n- Trust\n- Conversion\n- User confidence\n- Mobile experience\n\n\nFor every screen ask:\n\n1. What is the user's goal?\n2. Is the next action obvious?\n3. What causes confusion?\n4. What reduces conversion?\n\n\nIdentify:\n\n- UX friction\n- Missing screens\n- Missing states\n- Poor information architecture\n\n\n==================================================\nPHASE 6 — SECURITY AUDIT\n==================================================\n\nReview:\n\nAuthentication:\n\n- Password handling\n- Tokens\n- Sessions\n- Expiry\n\n\nAuthorization:\n\nCheck:\n\n- Customer accessing another customer data\n- Rider accessing restricted data\n- Merchant abusing permissions\n- Admin privilege escalation\n\n\nReview:\n\n- Secrets\n- Environment variables\n- SQL injection\n- XSS\n- CSRF\n- Rate limiting\n- File uploads\n- Sensitive data exposure\n\n\n==================================================\nPHASE 7 — DEVOPS/SRE REVIEW\n==================================================\n\nReview:\n\n- Deployment\n- Infrastructure\n- Docker\n- CI/CD\n- Monitoring\n- Logging\n- Backups\n- Rollbacks\n\n\nAsk:\n\n\"If production breaks at midnight, can the team detect and recover?\"\n\n\n==================================================\nPHASE 8 — BUSINESS AND FINANCIAL AUDIT\n==================================================\n\nAct as a business analyst and accountant.\n\nReview:\n\nRevenue model:\n\n- How SpeedPlus makes money\n- Commission logic\n- Fees\n- Margins\n\n\nFinancial controls:\n\nAudit:\n\n- Customer payment\n- Platform holding money\n- Merchant payout\n- Rider payout\n- Refunds\n\n\nFind:\n\n- Money leakage\n- Accounting gaps\n- Fraud opportunities\n\n\nMarketplace health:\n\nReview:\n\n- Customer incentives\n- Rider incentives\n- Merchant incentives\n- Operational scalability\n\n\n==================================================\nPHASE 9 — MARKETING REVIEW\n==================================================\n\nAct as Growth/Product Marketing Lead.\n\nReview:\n\n- Positioning\n- Value proposition\n- Landing page\n- Trust signals\n- Conversion funnel\n- Retention\n- Referral opportunities\n\n\nAnswer:\n\nWhy should a Nigerian customer BLOCKER:\n\nYes/No\n\n\n==================================================\nFINAL SIGN-OFF\n==================================================\n\nProvide:\n\n1. main() {\n\tgodotenv.Load()\n\n\tcfg, err := config.Load()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tslog.Error(\"config load failed\", \"error\", err)\n\t\tos.Exit(1)\n\t}\n\n\tif cfg.SentryDSN != \"\" {\n\t\tsentry.Init(sentry.ClientOptions{\n\t\t\tDsn:              cfg.SentryDSN,\n\t\t\tEnvironment:      cfg.Environment,\n\t\t\tTracesSampleRate: 0.1,\n\t\t})\n\t\tdefer sentry.Flush(2 * time.Second)\n\t}\n\n\tif err := runMigrations(cfg.DatabaseURL); err != nil {\n\t\tslog.Error(\"migrations failed\", \"error\", err)\n\t\tos.Exit(1)\n\t}\n\n\tgormDB, err := db.Connect(cfg.DatabaseURL, cfg.Environment == \"development\")\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tslog.Error(\"db connect failed\", \"error\", err)\n\t\tos.Exit(1)\n\t}\n\n\trdbOpts, _ := redis.ParseURL(cfg.RedisURL)\n\trdb := redis.NewClient(rdbOpts)\n\n\t// ── Repos ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\tuserRepo := repo.NewUserRepo(gormDB)\n\torderRepo := repo.NewOrderRepo(gormDB)\n\tledgerRepo := repo.NewLedgerRepo(gormDB)\n\tdispatchRepo := repo.NewDispatchRepo(gormDB)\n\t_ = dispatchRepo // consumed by services below\n\tmerchantRepo := repo.NewMerchantRepo(gormDB)\n\n\t// ── Email ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\temailClient, err := email.New(cfg)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tslog.Error(\"email client init failed\", \"error\", err)\n\t\tos.Exit(1)\n\t}\n\n\t// ── Services ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\tpaystackProvider := payment.NewPaystack(cfg.PaystackSecretKey)\n\tflutterwaveProvider := payment.NewFlutterwave(cfg.FlutterwaveSecretKey, cfg.FlutterwaveHash)\n\tmonnifyProvider := payment.NewMonnify(cfg.MonnifyAPIKey, cfg.MonnifySecretKey, cfg.MonnifyContractCode, cfg.MonnifyWalletAccountNumber)\n\tcatalogRepo := repo.NewCatalogRepo(gormDB)\n\tonboardingRepo := repo.NewOnboardingRepo(gormDB)\n\ttierRepo := repo.NewTierRepo(gormDB)\n\tdeliveryCodeRepo := repo.NewDeliveryCodeRepo(gormDB)\n\taffordabilityRepo := repo.NewAffordabilityRepo(gormDB)\n\tonboardingSvc := service.NewOnboardingService(onboardingRepo, cfg, monnifyProvider)\n\tonboardingSvc.InjectUserRepo(userRepo)\n\tauthSvc := service.NewAuthService(userRepo, cfg, onboardingSvc, emailClient)\n\tkycProvider := kyc.NewPrembly(cfg.PremblyAPIKey, cfg.PremblyBaseURL, cfg.PremblyAppID)\n\tkycSvc := service.NewKYCService(dispatchRepo, kycProvider)\n\tfeeConfigRepo := repo.NewFeeConfigRepo(gormDB)\n\tfeeConfigSvc := service.NewFeeConfigService(feeConfigRepo)\n\tpricingSvc := service.NewPricingService(orderRepo, cfg, cfg.OSRMURL, feeConfigSvc)\n\tledgerSvc := service.NewLedgerService(ledgerRepo, pricingSvc)\n\tledgerSvc.InjectFeeConfigs(feeConfigSvc)\n\ttierSvc := service.NewTierService(tierRepo)\n\torderSvc := service.NewOrderService(orderRepo, pricingSvc, ledgerSvc, tierSvc)\n\twalletRepo := repo.NewWalletRepo(gormDB)\n\twalletSvc := service.NewWalletService(walletRepo, ledgerSvc, authSvc, paystackProvider, emailClient, userRepo)\n\tdeliveryCodeSvc := service.NewDeliveryCodeService(deliveryCodeRepo)\n\t// R2 is optional at boot — proof-media endpoints fail closed (clear error,\n\t// not silent no-op) rather than block the whole API from starting when\n\t// media storage isn't configured yet (e.g. early dev).\n\tvar r2Client *storage.R2Client\n\tif r2c, err := storage.NewR2Client(context.Background(), storage.R2Config{\n\t\tAccountID: cfg.R2AccountID, AccessKeyID: cfg.R2AccessKeyID,\n\t\tSecretAccessKey: cfg.R2SecretAccessKey, BucketName: cfg.R2BucketName,\n\t}); err == nil {\n\t\tr2Client = r2c\n\t} else {\n\t\tslog.Warn(\"R2 storage not configured — proof-of-delivery media endpoints will error\", \"error\", err)\n\t}\n\tproofMediaRepo := repo.NewProofMediaRepo(gormDB)\n\tproofMediaSvc := service.NewProofMediaService(proofMediaRepo, orderRepo, r2Client)\n\torderSvc.InjectDeliveryCodes(deliveryCodeSvc)\n\torderSvc.InjectEmail(emailClient, userRepo)\n\tif len(cfg.EncryptionKey) == 32 {\n\t\tif recipientCipher, err := crypto.NewCipher([]byte(cfg.EncryptionKey)); err == nil {\n\t\t\torderSvc.InjectRecipientCipher(recipientCipher)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tslog.Error(\"recipient cipher init failed — package orders with recipient PII will error\", \"error\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t} else if cfg.Environment != \"production\" {\n\t\tslog.Warn(\"ENCRYPTION_KEY not set (or not 32 bytes) — recipient PII encryption disabled; package orders with recipient data will fail\")\n\t}\n\tloyaltyRepo := repo.NewLoyaltyRepo(gormDB)\n\tloyaltySvc := service.NewLoyaltyService(loyaltyRepo)\n\treferralRepo := repo.NewReferralRepo(gormDB)\n\treferralSvc := service.NewReferralService(referralRepo, userRepo, ledgerSvc, loyaltySvc)\n\tauthSvc.InjectReferrals(referralSvc)\n\tpaycodeRepo := repo.NewPaycodeRepo(gormDB)\n\tpaycodeSvc := service.NewPaycodeService(paycodeRepo, cfg, ledgerSvc, orderSvc, tierSvc, emailClient, userRepo, orderRepo, deliveryCodeSvc, referralSvc)\n\tpaymentLinkRepo := repo.NewPaymentLinkRepo(gormDB)\n\tpaymentLinkSvc := service.NewPaymentLinkService(paymentLinkRepo, ledgerSvc, paystackProvider, emailClient, userRepo)\n\tussdRepo := repo.NewUSSDRepo(gormDB)\n\tussdSvc := service.NewUSSDService(ussdRepo, monnifyProvider)\n\tgiftCardRepo := repo.NewGiftCardRepo(gormDB)\n\tgiftCardSvc := service.NewGiftCardService(giftCardRepo, ledgerSvc)\n\tsubscriptionRepo := repo.NewSubscriptionRepo(gormDB)\n\tsubscriptionSvc := service.NewSubscriptionService(subscriptionRepo, orderRepo, orderSvc, ledgerSvc)\n\tdispatchSvc := service.NewDispatchService(dispatchRepo)\n\trunRepo := repo.NewRunRepo(gormDB)\n\trunSvc := service.NewRunService(runRepo, orderRepo, pricingSvc, dispatchSvc)\n\tgasSvc := service.NewGasService(orderRepo)\n\tcatalogSvc := service.NewCatalogService(catalogRepo, r2Client)\n\tmerchantSvc := service.NewMerchantService(merchantRepo)\n\tadminRepo := repo.NewAdminRepo(gormDB)\n\tadminSvc := service.NewAdminService(adminRepo, ledgerSvc)\n\taffordabilitySvc := service.NewAffordabilityService(ledgerSvc, affordabilityRepo)\n\n\t// ── Asynq ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\tasynqClient := asynq.NewClient(asynq.RedisClientOpt{Addr: rdb.Options().Addr})\n\tdefer asynqClient.Close()\n\tauthSvc.InjectQueue(asynqClient, func(userID string) error {\n\t\treturn worker.EnqueueOnboarding(asynqClient, userID)\n\t})\n\twalletSvc.InjectQueue(func(cashoutID string) error {\n\t\treturn worker.EnqueueCashout(asynqClient, cashoutID)\n\t})\n\torderSvc.InjectReviewQueue(func(revieweeID, revieweeType string) error {\n\t\treturn worker.EnqueueReviewAggregate(asynqClient, revieweeID, revieweeType)\n\t})\n\n\tworkerHandlers := worker.NewHandlers(walletSvc, dispatchSvc, ledgerSvc, subscriptionSvc, onboardingSvc, asynqClient)\n\tworkerHandlers.InjectDB(gormDB)\n\tworkerHandlers.InjectOrders(orderSvc)\n\tworkerHandlers.InjectRuns(runSvc)\n\tasynqServer := worker.NewServer(cfg.RedisURL)\n\tasynqMux := asynq.NewServeMux()\n\tworkerHandlers.Register(asynqMux)\n\tgo func() {\n\t\tif err := asynqServer.Run(asynqMux); err != nil {\n\t\t\tslog.Error(\"asynq server error\", \"error\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t}()\n\n\tscheduler := worker.NewScheduler(cfg.RedisURL)\n\tgo func() {\n\t\tif err := scheduler.Run(); err != nil {\n\t\t\tslog.Error(\"asynq scheduler error\", \"error\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t}()\n\n\t// ── WS hub ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\thub := ws.NewHub(rdb)\n\thub.Start(context.Background())\n\n\t// Wire dispatch + hub into order service now that both are constructed.\n\torderSvc.InjectDispatch(dispatchSvc, hub)\n\t// Wire order service into dispatch for state-machine-safe ManualAssign.\n\tdispatchSvc.InjectOrders(orderSvc)\n\n\t// ── Handlers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\thealthH := handler.NewHealthHandler(gormDB, rdb)\n\tauthH := handler.NewAuthHandler(authSvc)\n\tusersH := handler.NewUsersHandler(userRepo)\n\tkycH := handler.NewKYCHandler(kycSvc)\n\torderH := handler.NewOrderHandler(orderSvc)\n\tproofMediaH := handler.NewProofMediaHandler(proofMediaSvc)\n\twalletH := handler.NewWalletHandler(walletSvc, ledgerSvc, userRepo)\n\tif cfg.BridgeEnabled && cfg.BridgeAPIKey != \"\" {\n\t\twalletH.SetBridge(payment.NewBridge(cfg.BridgeAPIKey))\n\t}\n\tpaycodeH := handler.NewPaycodeHandler(paycodeSvc)\n\tdispatchH := handler.NewDispatchHandler(dispatchSvc)\n\tcardH := handler.NewCardHandler(paycodeSvc, authSvc, gormDB)\n\tpaymentLinkH := handler.NewPaymentLinkHandler(paymentLinkSvc)\n\tussdH := handler.NewUSSDHandler(ussdSvc)\n\tloyaltyH := handler.NewLoyaltyHandler(loyaltySvc)\n\tgiftCardH := handler.NewGiftCardHandler(giftCardSvc)\n\tsubscriptionH := handler.NewSubscriptionHandler(subscriptionSvc)\n\tgasH := handler.NewGasHandler(gasSvc)\n\trunH := handler.NewRunHandler(runSvc)\n\tcatalogH := handler.NewCatalogHandler(catalogSvc)\n\tmerchantH := handler.NewMerchantHandler(merchantSvc, orderSvc, catalogSvc, walletSvc)\n\tadminH := handler.NewAdminHandler(adminSvc, ledgerSvc, feeConfigSvc)\n\taffordabilityH := handler.NewAffordabilityHandler(affordabilitySvc)\n\tpricingH := handler.NewPricingHandler(pricingSvc)\n\n\t// ── Router ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\tif cfg.Environment == \"production\" {\n\t\tgin.SetMode(gin.ReleaseMode)\n\t}\n\n\tr := gin.New()\n\n\t// SetTrustedProxies MUST be called explicitly. Gin's default (no call)\n\t// trusts every proxy, meaning ClientIP() honors a client-supplied\n\t// X-Forwarded-For header verbatim — trivially spoofable, which would let\n\t// any caller rotate the header per-request to bypass the per-IP rate\n\t// limiters in middleware.RateLimit. TRUSTED_PROXIES is a comma-separated\n\t// CIDR list (set to your load balancer/ingress); unset means trust none,\n\t// so ClientIP() falls back to the raw TCP peer address.\n\tif proxies := os.Getenv(\"TRUSTED_PROXIES\"); proxies != \"\" {\n\t\tr.SetTrustedProxies(strings.Split(proxies, \",\"))\n\t} else {\n\t\tr.SetTrustedProxies(nil)\n\t}\n\n\tr.Use(\n\t\tmiddleware.Recovery(),\n\t\tmiddleware.RequestID(),\n\t\tmiddleware.Logger(),\n\t\tmiddleware.CORS(middleware.AllowedOrigins(os.Getenv(\"ALLOWED_ORIGINS\"))),\n\t)\n\n\tr.GET(\"/healthz\", healthH.Healthz)\n\tr.GET(\"/readyz\", healthH.Readyz)\n\n\twebhooks := r.Group(\"/webhooks\")\n\t{\n\t\twebhooks.POST(\"/paystack\", walletH.HandlePaystackWebhook(paystackProvider))\n\t\twebhooks.POST(\"/flutterwave\", walletH.HandleFlutterwaveWebhook(flutterwaveProvider))\n\t\twebhooks.POST(\"/monnify\", walletH.HandleMonnifyWebhook(monnifyProvider))\n\t\tif cfg.BridgeEnabled && cfg.BridgeAPIKey != \"\" {\n\t\t\tbridgeProvider := payment.NewBridge(cfg.BridgeAPIKey)\n\t\t\twebhooks.POST(\"/bridge\", walletH.HandleBridgeWebhook(bridgeProvider))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tv1 := r.Group(\"/api/v1\")\n\n\tauthGroup := v1.Group(\"/auth\")\n\tauthGroup.Use(middleware.RateLimit(rdb, \"auth\", 10, time.Minute))\n\t{\n\t\tauthGroup.POST(\"/register\", authH.Register)\n\t\tauthGroup.POST(\"/login\", authH.Login)\n\t\tauthGroup.POST(\"/logout\", authH.Logout)\n\t\tauthGroup.POST(\"/refresh\", authH.Refresh)\n\t\tauthGroup.POST(\"/pin/set\", middleware.Auth(authSvc), authH.SetPIN)\n\t\tauthGroup.POST(\"/pin/verify\", middleware.Auth(authSvc), authH.VerifyPIN)\n\t}\n\n\totpGroup := v1.Group(\"/otp\")\n\totpGroup.Use(middleware.RateLimit(rdb, \"otp\", 3, 5*time.Minute))\n\t{\n\t\totpGroup.POST(\"/request\", authH.RequestOTP)\n\t\totpGroup.POST(\"/verify\", authH.VerifyOTP)\n\t}\n\n\tauthed := v1.Group(\"\")\n\tauthed.Use(middleware.Auth(authSvc))\n\n\t// Users\n\tauthed.GET(\"/users/me\", usersH.Me)\n\tauthed.PUT(\"/users/me\", usersH.UpdateMe)\n\tauthed.GET(\"/users/me/addresses\", usersH.ListAddresses)\n\tauthed.POST(\"/users/me/addresses\", usersH.CreateAddress)\n\tauthed.GET(\"/users/me/driver-profile\", middleware.RequireRole(\"driver\"), usersH.GetDriverProfile)\n\tauthed.GET(\"/users/me/merchant-profile\", middleware.RequireRole(\"merchant\"), usersH.GetMerchantProfile)\n\n\t// Catalog — public browse (no auth required)\n\tv1.GET(\"/merchants\", catalogH.ListMerchants)\n\tv1.GET(\"/merchants/:id\", catalogH.GetMerchant)\n\tv1.GET(\"/products\", catalogH.ListProducts)\n\tv1.GET(\"/products/search\", catalogH.SearchProducts)\n\tv1.GET(\"/products/:id\", catalogH.GetProduct)\n\n\t// Prescriptions (auth required, row-level ownership enforced in handler).\n\t// Rate-limited + idempotent: this is a controlled-substance-adjacent\n\t// write, not a generic list/get.\n\tprescriptions := authed.Group(\"/prescriptions\")\n\t{\n\t\tprescriptions.POST(\"/presign\", middleware.RateLimit(rdb, \"rx-presign\", 5, time.Minute), catalogH.PresignPrescriptionUpload)\n\t\tprescriptions.POST(\"\", middleware.RateLimit(rdb, \"rx-create\", 5, time.Minute), middleware.Idempotency(rdb, 24*time.Hour), catalogH.CreatePrescription)\n\t\tprescriptions.GET(\"\", catalogH.ListPrescriptions)\n\t\tprescriptions.GET(\"/:id\", catalogH.GetPrescription)\n\t}\n\n\t// KYC\n\tkyc := authed.Group(\"/kyc\")\n\t{\n\t\tkyc.POST(\"/check\", kycH.SubmitCheck)\n\t}\n\n\t// Quotes\n\tauthed.POST(\"/quotes\", pricingH.Quote)\n\tauthed.POST(\"/quotes/multistop\", pricingH.QuoteMultiStop)\n\n\t// Orders\n\torders := authed.Group(\"/orders\")\n\t{\n\t\torders.GET(\"\", orderH.List)\n\t\torders.POST(\"\", middleware.RequireVerified(), middleware.RateLimit(rdb, \"order-create\", 10, time.Minute), middleware.Idempotency(rdb, 24*time.Hour), orderH.Create)\n\t\torders.GET(\"/:id\", orderH.GetByID)\n\t\torders.GET(\"/:id/track\", orderH.GetByID)\n\t\torders.GET(\"/:id/receipt\", orderH.Receipt)\n\t\torders.POST(\"/:id/review\", middleware.Idempotency(rdb, 24*time.Hour), orderH.Review)\n\t\torders.GET(\"/:id/stops\", orderH.GetStops)\n\t\torders.POST(\"/:id/stops/confirm\", middleware.RequireRole(\"driver\"), orderH.ConfirmStop)\n\t\torders.POST(\"/:id/cancel\", middleware.RateLimit(rdb, \"order-cancel\", 5, time.Minute), orderH.Cancel)\n\t\torders.POST(\"/:id/proof/presign\", middleware.RequireRole(\"driver\"), proofMediaH.PresignUpload)\n\t\torders.POST(\"/:id/proof/confirm\", middleware.RequireRole(\"driver\"), proofMediaH.ConfirmUpload)\n\t\torders.GET(\"/:id/proof\", proofMediaH.GetMedia)\n\t}\n\n\t// Driver badges — public, no auth required\n\tv1.GET(\"/drivers/:id/badges\", orderH.DriverBadges)\n\n\t// Wallet\n\twallet := authed.Group(\"/wallet\")\n\t{\n\t\twallet.GET(\"\", walletH.GetBalance)\n\t\twallet.GET(\"/transactions\", walletH.GetTransactions)\n\t\twallet.GET(\"/affordability\", affordabilityH.GetAffordability)\n\t\twallet.POST(\"/fund\", middleware.RequireVerified(), middleware.Idempotency(rdb, 24*time.Hour), walletH.Fund)\n\t\twallet.POST(\"/fund/crypto\", middleware.RequireVerified(), middleware.Idempotency(rdb, 24*time.Hour), walletH.FundCrypto)\n\t\t// Rate-limited: /transfer resolves recipients by phone/username before\n\t\t// moving money, which is an enumeration surface (does this\n\t\t// phone/username have an account). The recipient-name reveal itself\n\t\t// is intentional anti-misdirected-payment UX (confirm you're paying\n\t\t// the right person, same pattern PayPal/Venmo use) — throttling the\n\t\t// lookup rate is the actual mitigation, not hiding the name.\n\t\twallet.POST(\"/transfer\", middleware.RequireVerified(), middleware.RateLimit(rdb, \"wallet-transfer\", 10, time.Minute), middleware.Idempotency(rdb, 24*time.Hour), walletH.Transfer)\n\t}\n\n\t// EWA\n\tearnings := authed.Group(\"/earnings\")\n\tearnings.Use(middleware.RequireRole(\"driver\"))\n\t{\n\t\tearnings.POST(\"/cashout\", middleware.Idempotency(rdb, 24*time.Hour), walletH.EWACashout)\n\t}\n\n\t// Paycodes\n\tpaycodes := authed.Group(\"/paycodes\")\n\tpaycodes.Use(middleware.RateLimit(rdb, \"paycodes\", 20, time.Minute))\n\t{\n\t\tpaycodes.POST(\"/generate\", paycodeH.Generate)\n\t\tpaycodes.POST(\"/resolve\", middleware.RequireRole(\"driver\"), paycodeH.Resolve)\n\t\tpaycodes.POST(\"/confirm-code\", middleware.RequireRole(\"driver\"), paycodeH.ConfirmByCode)\n\t\tpaycodes.POST(\"/:id/confirm\", middleware.RequireRole(\"driver\"), paycodeH.Confirm)\n\t\tpaycodes.POST(\"/scan-card\", middleware.RequireRole(\"driver\"), cardH.ScanCard)\n\t}\n\n\t// User wallet + virtual account + trust tier + card\n\tauthed.GET(\"/users/me/virtual-account\", cardH.GetVirtualAccount)\n\tauthed.GET(\"/users/me/trust-tier\", cardH.GetTrustTier)\n\tauthed.GET(\"/users/me/card\", cardH.GetCard)\n\n\t// Payment links\n\tpaymentLinks := authed.Group(\"/payment-links\")\n\t{\n\t\tpaymentLinks.POST(\"\", paymentLinkH.Create)\n\t\tpaymentLinks.POST(\"/:slug/pay\", middleware.Idempotency(rdb, 24*time.Hour), paymentLinkH.PayByWallet)\n\t}\n\t// Public payment link endpoints (no auth)\n\tv1.GET(\"/pay/:slug\", paymentLinkH.GetBySlug)\n\tv1.POST(\"/pay/:slug/guest\", paymentLinkH.InitiateGuestPayment)\n\n\t// USSD wallet funding\n\tussd := authed.Group(\"/wallet/ussd\")\n\t{\n\t\tussd.GET(\"/banks\", ussdH.Banks)\n\t\tussd.POST(\"/initiate\", middleware.Idempotency(rdb, 30*time.Minute), ussdH.Initiate)\n\t\tussd.GET(\"/intents/:id\", ussdH.Status)\n\t}\n\n\t\t// Loyalty\n\tloyalty := authed.Group(\"/loyalty\")\n\t{\n\t\tloyalty.GET(\"\", loyaltyH.GetBalance)\n\t\tloyalty.GET(\"/history\", loyaltyH.GetHistory)\n\t}\n\n\t// Gift cards\n\tgiftCards := authed.Group(\"/gift-cards\")\n\t{\n\t\tgiftCards.POST(\"\", giftCardH.Issue)\n\t\tgiftCards.POST(\"/redeem\", giftCardH.Redeem)\n\t}\n\n\t// Subscriptions\n\tsubs := authed.Group(\"/subscriptions\")\n\t{\n\t\tsubs.POST(\"\", subscriptionH.Create)\n\t\tsubs.POST(\"/:id/pause\", subscriptionH.Pause)\n\t\tsubs.POST(\"/:id/cancel\", subscriptionH.Cancel)\n\t}\n\n\t// Gas LPG price index — public read\n\tv1.GET(\"/gas/price-index\", subscriptionH.GetLPGPrice)\n\tv1.GET(\"/gas/specs\", gasH.ListSpecs)\n\n\t// Customer cylinder registry\n\tcylinders := authed.Group(\"/cylinders\")\n\tcylinders.Use(middleware.RequireRole(\"customer\"))\n\t{\n\t\tcylinders.GET(\"\", gasH.ListCylinders)\n\t\tcylinders.POST(\"\", middleware.RateLimit(rdb, \"cylinder-register\", 10, time.Minute), gasH.RegisterCylinder)\n\t\tcylinders.POST(\"/:id/retire\", gasH.RetireCylinder)\n\t}\n\n\t// ── Merchant self-service (\n\t\"context\"\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"time\"\n\n\t\"github.com/google/uuid\"\n\t\"github.com/speedplus/api/internal/model\"\n\t\"github.com/speedplus/api/internal/observability\"\n\t\"github.com/speedplus/api/internal/repo\"\n\t\"gorm.io/gorm\"\n)\n\ntype LedgerService struct {\n\trepo       repo.LedgerRepo\n\tpricing    *PricingService\n\tfeeConfigs *FeeConfigService // nil => DefaultFeeTable fallback\n}\n\nfunc NewLedgerService(r repo.LedgerRepo, pricing *PricingService) *LedgerService {\n\treturn &LedgerService{repo: r, pricing: pricing}\n}\n\n// InjectFeeConfigs wires the FeeConfigService after construction to break the\n// circular dependency: LedgerService ← FeeConfigService ← (nothing).\nfunc (s *LedgerService) InjectFeeConfigs(fc *FeeConfigService) {\n\ts.feeConfigs = fc\n}\n\n// ── Core journal writer ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nfunc (s *LedgerService) journal(ctx context.Context, tx *gorm.DB, entries []model.LedgerEntry) error {\n\tvar sum int64\n\tfor _, e := range entries {\n\t\tsum += e.AmountKobo\n\t}\n\tif sum != 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"ledger invariant violated: journal sums to %d, must be 0\", sum)\n\t}\n\treturn s.repo.CreateEntries(ctx, tx, entries)\n}\n\nfunc (s *LedgerService) adjustBalance(ctx context.Context, tx *gorm.DB, accountID uuid.UUID, deltaKobo int64) error {\n\tbal, err := s.repo.LockBalance(ctx, tx, accountID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tnewBal := bal.BalanceKobo + deltaKobo\n\tif newBal < 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"%w: have %d kobo, need %d\", ErrInsufficientBalance, bal.BalanceKobo, -deltaKobo)\n\t}\n\treturn s.repo.UpdateBalance(ctx, tx, accountID, newBal)\n}\n\n// ── Account helpers (used by other services) ──────────────────────────────────\n\nfunc (s *LedgerService) EnsureWallet(ctx context.Context, tx *gorm.DB, ownerID uuid.UUID) (*model.LedgerAccount, error) {\n\treturn s.repo.FindOrCreateWallet(ctx, tx, ownerID)\n}\n\n// EnsureMerchantWallet resolves a merchants.id to its owning user before\n// touching the ledger. ledger_accounts.owner_id carries an FK to users(id), so\n// every ledger account — merchant ones included — is keyed by User.ID.\n// Passing model.Merchant.ID straight through is an FK violation, not merely a\n// lookup miss.\nfunc (s *LedgerService) EnsureMerchantWallet(ctx context.Context, tx *gorm.DB, merchantID uuid.UUID) (*model.LedgerAccount, error) {\n\tuserID, err := s.repo.FindMerchantUserID(ctx, tx, merchantID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"resolve merchant %s to user: %w\", merchantID, err)\n\t}\n\treturn s.repo.FindOrCreateWallet(ctx, tx, userID)\n}\n\nfunc (s *LedgerService) platformAccount(ctx context.Context, tx *gorm.DB, acctType model.AccountType) (*model.LedgerAccount, error) {\n\treturn s.repo.FindOrCreatePlatformAccount(ctx, tx, acctType)\n}\n\n// ── Escrow hold ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nfunc (s *LedgerService) HoldEscrow(ctx context.Context, tx *gorm.DB, orderID, customerID uuid.UUID, amountKobo int64) error {\n\tcustomerWallet, err := s.EnsureWallet(ctx, tx, customerID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tescrowAcct, err := s.platformAccount(ctx, tx, model.AccountEscrow)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tjournalID := uuid.New()\n\tentries := []model.LedgerEntry{\n\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: customerWallet.ID, AmountKobo: -amountKobo, Description: \"escrow hold\", RefType: \"order\", RefID: &orderID},\n\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: escrowAcct.ID, AmountKobo: amountKobo, Description: \"escrow hold\", RefType: \"order\", RefID: &orderID},\n\t}\n\tif err := s.journal(ctx, tx, entries); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tif err := s.adjustBalance(ctx, tx, customerWallet.ID, -amountKobo); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\t// Materialise escrow platform balance so reconciliation can assert it in O(1).\n\tif err := s.adjustBalance(ctx, tx, escrowAcct.ID, amountKobo); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"hold escrow: adjust escrow balance: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\thold := &model.EscrowHold{\n\t\tID:         uuid.New(),\n\t\tOrderID:    orderID,\n\t\tAccountID:  escrowAcct.ID,\n\t\tAmountKobo: amountKobo,\n\t\tStatus:     model.EscrowHeld,\n\t}\n\treturn s.repo.CreateEscrowHold(ctx, tx, hold)\n}\n\n// ── Settlement ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n// shortfallTolerance is the fraction of ordered weight within which no refund\n// is issued. 2% on a 12.5kg cylinder = 250g tolerance.\nconst shortfallTolerance = 0.02\n\n// weightProof loads the weight_photo proof row for a gas order and returns\n// the measured kg. Returns 0, nil only when no weight_photo row exists yet —\n// any other DB error is propagated, never swallowed. A swallowed error here\n// would look identical to \"no proof\" and silently skip the shortfall refund.\nfunc (s *LedgerService) weightProof(ctx context.Context, tx *gorm.DB, orderID uuid.UUID) (float64, error) {\n\tvar proof model.ProofMedia\n\terr := tx.WithContext(ctx).\n\t\tWhere(\"order_id = ? AND kind = 'weight_photo'\", orderID).\n\t\tOrder(\"captured_at DESC\").\n\t\tFirst(&proof).Error\n\tif errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {\n\t\treturn 0, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn 0, fmt.Errorf(\"load weight proof: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tif proof.MeasuredKg == nil {\n\t\treturn 0, nil\n\t}\n\treturn *proof.MeasuredKg, nil\n}\n\n// orderedWeightKg sums the ordered weight directly from order_items via tx,\n// rather than trusting order.Items to be populated. Settle is called with\n// orders loaded by LockOrderTx / FindActiveInTransitOrder (paycode.go), none\n// of which preload Items — relying on the in-memory struct here would make\n// this always read 0 and silently skip every gas shortfall calculation in\n// production, while still passing tests that construct Order with Items set\n// by hand.\nfunc (s *LedgerService) orderedWeightKg(ctx context.Context, tx *gorm.DB, orderID uuid.UUID) (float64, error) {\n\tvar orderedKg float64\n\terr := tx.WithContext(ctx).Model(&model.OrderItem{}).\n\t\tWhere(\"order_id = ?\", orderID).\n\t\tSelect(\"COALESCE(SUM(weight_kg * quantity), 0)\").\n\t\tScan(&orderedKg).Error\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn 0, fmt.Errorf(\"load ordered weight: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn orderedKg, nil\n}\n\n// liveLPGPriceKobo returns the current LPG price per kg for a region, or 0 if\n// no index row exists yet. Used to price gas shortfall refunds in new_cylinder\n// mode, where SubtotalKobo includes the cylinder body and is not a reliable\n// ₦/kg basis.\nfunc (s *LedgerService) liveLPGPriceKobo(ctx context.Context, tx *gorm.DB, region string) (int64, error) {\n\tvar row model.LPGPriceIndex\n\terr := tx.WithContext(ctx).\n\t\tWhere(\"region = ? AND effective_at <= NOW()\", region).\n\t\tOrder(\"effective_at DESC\").\n\t\tFirst(&row).Error\n\tif errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {\n\t\treturn 0, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn 0, fmt.Errorf(\"load lpg price: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn row.PricePerKgKobo, nil\n}\n\nfunc (s *LedgerService) Settle(ctx context.Context, tx *gorm.DB, order *model.Order, paycodeEventID uuid.UUID) error {\n\t// Pin the split to the fee config in force when the order was created —\n\t// an admin rate change mid-delivery must never reallocate money in flight.\n\tvar fees FeeConfig\n\tif s.feeConfigs != nil {\n\t\tfees = s.feeConfigs.GetFeesAt(ctx, order.Vertical, order.CreatedAt)\n\t} else {\n\t\tfees = defaultFees(order.Vertical)\n\t}\n\n\thold, err := s.repo.LockEscrowHold(ctx, tx, order.ID, model.EscrowHeld)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"escrow hold not found: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\t// Gas orders must never settle without a weight photo — this is the\n\t// trust wedge the whole gas vertical rests on. Enforced here, inside\n\t// Settle, so every current and future confirmation path (QR, code, card)\n\t// is covered by construction rather than by remembering to add a check\n\t// at each new call site. Fetched once and reused below for the shortfall\n\t// calculation, so the guard and the calculation can never read different\n\t// data — \"has a weight photo\" and \"has a measured_kg to price against\"\n\t// are the same fact by construction, not two separately-maintained checks.\n\tvar gasMeasuredKg float64\n\tvar gasOrderedKg float64 // hoisted so plausibility check and shortfall block share one DB read\n\tif order.Vertical == \"gas\" {\n\t\tvar err error\n\t\tgasMeasuredKg, err = s.weightProof(ctx, tx, order.ID)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"settle: weight proof: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif gasMeasuredKg <= 0 {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"gas order requires a weight photo before settlement\")\n\t\t}\n\t\tgasOrderedKg, err = s.orderedWeightKg(ctx, tx, order.ID)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"settle: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Plausibility band: reject implausible scale readings before any money\n\t\t// moves. A typo (e.g. 1.25 instead of 12.5) or a tampered photo must\n\t\t// not zero a merchant's entire payout. Band is intentionally wide\n\t\t// (50%–150% of ordered) so legitimate edge cases (tare variance,\n\t\t// overfill) are never blocked; only clear data-entry errors are caught.\n\t\tif gasOrderedKg > 0 {\n\t\t\tlo, hi := gasOrderedKg*0.5, gasOrderedKg*1.5\n\t\t\tif gasMeasuredKg < lo || gasMeasuredKg > hi {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"settle: measured weight %.2f kg is outside plausible range [%.2f, %.2f] for ordered %.2f kg — verify scale reading\",\n\t\t\t\t\tgasMeasuredKg, lo, hi, gasOrderedKg)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tmerchantShareKobo := int64(float64(order.SubtotalKobo) * fees.MerchantTakeRate)\n\tdriverEarningKobo := int64(float64(order.DeliveryKobo) * fees.DriverTakeRate)\n\n\t// Gas shortfall refund: if measured < ordered beyond tolerance, debit the\n\t// shortfall from the merchant's share and credit it to the customer —\n\t// within this same balanced journal.\n\tvar shortfallRefundKobo int64\n\tif order.Vertical == \"gas\" {\n\t\torderedKg := gasOrderedKg // already loaded and plausibility-checked above\n\t\tif orderedKg > 0 {\n\t\t\tshortKg := orderedKg - gasMeasuredKg\n\t\t\tif shortKg > orderedKg*shortfallTolerance {\n\t\t\t\t// price per kg = subtotal / orderedKg. In new_cylinder mode\n\t\t\t\t// the subtotal includes the cylinder body, not just the\n\t\t\t\t// gas fill, so subtotal/kg overstates ₦/kg — price off the\n\t\t\t\t// LPG index instead when one is available.\n\t\t\t\tpricePerKg := float64(order.SubtotalKobo) / orderedKg\n\t\t\t\tif order.GasMode != nil && *order.GasMode == \"new_cylinder\" {\n\t\t\t\t\tlpgPriceKobo, err := s.liveLPGPriceKobo(ctx, tx, \"Lagos\")\n\t\t\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"settle: lpg price: %w\", err)\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\tif lpgPriceKobo > 0 {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tpricePerKg = float64(lpgPriceKobo)\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tshortfallRefundKobo = int64(shortKg * pricePerKg)\n\t\t\t\t// Cap at merchant's share — never go negative\n\t\t\t\tif shortfallRefundKobo > merchantShareKobo {\n\t\t\t\t\tshortfallRefundKobo = merchantShareKobo\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tmerchantShareKobo -= shortfallRefundKobo\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tplatformTotal := (order.SubtotalKobo - merchantShareKobo) + (order.DeliveryKobo - driverEarningKobo) + order.ServiceKobo\n\n\tif order.DriverID == nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"cannot settle: no driver assigned\")\n\t}\n\n\t// FIX #3: propagate all account/wallet lookup errors — no more _, _ discards.\n\tescrowAcct, err := s.platformAccount(ctx, tx, model.AccountEscrow)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"settle: escrow account: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\trevenueAcct, err := s.platformAccount(ctx, tx, model.AccountRevenue)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"settle: revenue account: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tmerchantWallet, err := s.EnsureMerchantWallet(ctx, tx, order.MerchantID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"settle: merchant wallet: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tdriverWallet, err := s.EnsureWallet(ctx, tx, *order.DriverID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"settle: driver wallet: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\t// FIX #1: base escrow debit covers only subtotal+delivery+service.\n\t// The tip is held in escrow too (HoldEscrow used TotalKobo = base+tip),\n\t// but we debit it in a separate journal line below so the invariant holds\n\t// for both the base block and the tip block independently.\n\tbaseHoldKobo := order.SubtotalKobo + order.DeliveryKobo + order.ServiceKobo\n\n\tjournalID := uuid.New()\n\tentries := []model.LedgerEntry{\n\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: escrowAcct.ID, AmountKobo: -baseHoldKobo, Description: \"settlement debit escrow\", RefType: \"order\", RefID: &order.ID},\n\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: merchantWallet.ID, AmountKobo: merchantShareKobo, Description: \"merchant settlement\", RefType: \"order\", RefID: &order.ID},\n\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: driverWallet.ID, AmountKobo: driverEarningKobo, Description: \"driver delivery fee\", RefType: \"order\", RefID: &order.ID},\n\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: revenueAcct.ID, AmountKobo: platformTotal, Description: \"platform fee\", RefType: \"order\", RefID: &order.ID},\n\t}\n\t// Shortfall refund: credit customer from the already-reduced merchant share.\n\t// The escrow debit above covers the full baseHoldKobo; the shortfall is\n\t// redistributed within the journal so the zero-sum invariant still holds.\n\tif shortfallRefundKobo > 0 {\n\t\tcustomerWallet, err := s.EnsureWallet(ctx, tx, order.CustomerID)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"settle: customer wallet for shortfall: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tentries = append(entries,\n\t\t\tmodel.LedgerEntry{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: revenueAcct.ID, AmountKobo: -shortfallRefundKobo, Description: \"gas shortfall debit platform\", RefType: \"order\", RefID: &order.ID},\n\t\t\tmodel.LedgerEntry{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: customerWallet.ID, AmountKobo: shortfallRefundKobo, Description: \"gas shortfall refund to customer\", RefType: \"order\", RefID: &order.ID},\n\t\t)\n\t\tif err := s.adjustBalance(ctx, tx, customerWallet.ID, shortfallRefundKobo); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"settle: adjust customer balance for shortfall: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\t// Tip block: separate escrow debit + driver credit — sums to zero on its own.\n\tif order.TipKobo > 0 {\n\t\tentries = append(entries,\n\t\t\tmodel.LedgerEntry{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: escrowAcct.ID, AmountKobo: -order.TipKobo, Description: \"tip debit escrow\", RefType: \"order\", RefID: &order.ID},\n\t\t\tmodel.LedgerEntry{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: driverWallet.ID, AmountKobo: order.TipKobo, Description: \"tip 100% driver\", RefType: \"order\", RefID: &order.ID},\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\n\tif err := s.journal(ctx, tx, entries); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\t// Materialise escrow balance: debit the full hold (base + tip).\n\tif err := s.adjustBalance(ctx, tx, escrowAcct.ID, -(baseHoldKobo + order.TipKobo)); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"settle: adjust escrow balance: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tif err := s.adjustBalance(ctx, tx, merchantWallet.ID, merchantShareKobo); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"settle: adjust merchant balance: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tif err := s.adjustBalance(ctx, tx, driverWallet.ID, driverEarningKobo+order.TipKobo); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"settle: adjust driver balance: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tif err := s.repo.CreateDriverEarning(ctx, tx, &model.DriverEarning{\n\t\tID:         uuid.New(),\n\t\tDriverID:   *order.DriverID,\n\t\tOrderID:    order.ID,\n\t\tAmountKobo: driverEarningKobo,\n\t\tTipKobo:    order.TipKobo,\n\t}); err != nil {\n\t\tobservability.CaptureError(ctx, err, \"settle: create driver earning\", \"order_id\", order.ID.String())\n\t\t// non-fatal: earning row missing is recoverable; settlement itself must not roll back\n\t}\n\n\tnow := time.Now()\n\thold.Status = model.EscrowReleased\n\thold.ReleasedAt = &now\n\thold.ReleasedBy = &paycodeEventID\n\treturn s.repo.SaveEscrowHold(ctx, tx, hold)\n}\n\n// ── Cancellation refund engine ────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nfunc (s *LedgerService) ProcessCancellationRefund(ctx context.Context, tx *gorm.DB, order *model.Order) error {\n\trule, err := s.repo.FindCancellationRule(ctx, order.Vertical, string(order.Status))\n\tif err != nil || rule.FullRefund {\n\t\treturn s.fullRefund(ctx, tx, order)\n\t}\n\n\thold, err := s.repo.LockEscrowHold(ctx, tx, order.ID, model.EscrowHeld)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"escrow hold not found for refund\")\n\t}\n\n\tmerchantComp := rule.MerchantCompKobo\n\tif rule.MerchantCompPct > 0 {\n\t\tmerchantComp = int64(float64(order.SubtotalKobo) * rule.MerchantCompPct)\n\t}\n\tvar riderComp int64\n\tif rule.RiderCompPctOfDelivery > 0 && order.DriverID != nil {\n\t\triderComp = int64(float64(order.DeliveryKobo) * rule.RiderCompPctOfDelivery)\n\t}\n\trefundKobo := hold.AmountKobo - merchantComp - riderComp\n\tif refundKobo < 0 {\n\t\trefundKobo = 0\n\t}\n\n\tescrowAcct, err := s.platformAccount(ctx, tx, model.AccountEscrow)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"refund: escrow account: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tcustomerWallet, err := s.EnsureWallet(ctx, tx, order.CustomerID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"refund: customer wallet: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tjournalID := uuid.New()\n\tentries := []model.LedgerEntry{\n\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: escrowAcct.ID, AmountKobo: -hold.AmountKobo, Description: \"cancellation refund debit escrow\", RefType: \"order\", RefID: &order.ID},\n\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: customerWallet.ID, AmountKobo: refundKobo, Description: \"cancellation refund to customer\", RefType: \"order\", RefID: &order.ID},\n\t}\n\tif merchantComp > 0 {\n\t\tmw, err := s.EnsureMerchantWallet(ctx, tx, order.MerchantID)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"refund: merchant wallet: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tentries = append(entries, model.LedgerEntry{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: mw.ID, AmountKobo: merchantComp, Description: \"merchant prep compensation\", RefType: \"order\", RefID: &order.ID})\n\t\tif err := s.adjustBalance(ctx, tx, mw.ID, merchantComp); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"refund: adjust merchant balance: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif riderComp > 0 && order.DriverID != nil {\n\t\tdw, err := s.EnsureWallet(ctx, tx, *order.DriverID)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"refund: driver wallet: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tentries = append(entries, model.LedgerEntry{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: dw.ID, AmountKobo: riderComp, Description: \"rider distance compensation\", RefType: \"order\", RefID: &order.ID})\n\t\tif err := s.adjustBalance(ctx, tx, dw.ID, riderComp); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"refund: adjust rider balance: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tif err := s.journal(ctx, tx, entries); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tif err := s.adjustBalance(ctx, tx, escrowAcct.ID, -hold.AmountKobo); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"refund: adjust escrow balance: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tif err := s.adjustBalance(ctx, tx, customerWallet.ID, refundKobo); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"refund: adjust customer balance: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tnow := time.Now()\n\thold.Status = model.EscrowReversed\n\thold.ReleasedAt = &now\n\treturn s.repo.SaveEscrowHold(ctx, tx, hold)\n}\n\nfunc (s *LedgerService) fullRefund(ctx context.Context, tx *gorm.DB, order *model.Order) error {\n\thold, err := s.repo.LockEscrowHold(ctx, tx, order.ID, model.EscrowHeld)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\t// FIX #5: propagate the error — returning nil here silently skips the refund.\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"full refund: escrow hold not found: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tescrowAcct, err := s.platformAccount(ctx, tx, model.AccountEscrow)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"full refund: escrow account: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tcustomerWallet, err := s.EnsureWallet(ctx, tx, order.CustomerID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"full refund: customer wallet: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tjournalID := uuid.New()\n\tentries := []model.LedgerEntry{\n\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: escrowAcct.ID, AmountKobo: -hold.AmountKobo, Description: \"full refund debit escrow\", RefType: \"order\", RefID: &order.ID},\n\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: customerWallet.ID, AmountKobo: hold.AmountKobo, Description: \"full refund to customer wallet\", RefType: \"order\", RefID: &order.ID},\n\t}\n\tif err := s.journal(ctx, tx, entries); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tif err := s.adjustBalance(ctx, tx, escrowAcct.ID, -hold.AmountKobo); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"full refund: adjust escrow balance: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tif err := s.adjustBalance(ctx, tx, customerWallet.ID, hold.AmountKobo); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"full refund: adjust customer balance: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tnow := time.Now()\n\thold.Status = model.EscrowReversed\n\thold.ReleasedAt = &now\n\treturn s.repo.SaveEscrowHold(ctx, tx, hold)\n}\n\n// ── Wallet credit (pay-in) ────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n// CreditWallet journals an inbound payment from a provider.\n// FIX #4: debit AccountProviderClearing (asset in transit), NOT AccountRevenue.\n// Revenue is only recognised at settlement time (platform fee entry in Settle).\nfunc (s *LedgerService) CreditWallet(ctx context.Context, tx *gorm.DB, userID uuid.UUID, amountKobo int64, refType string, refID *uuid.UUID) error {\n\twallet, err := s.EnsureWallet(ctx, tx, userID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tclearingAcct, err := s.platformAccount(ctx, tx, model.AccountProviderClearing)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"credit wallet: clearing account: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tjournalID := uuid.New()\n\tentries := []model.LedgerEntry{\n\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: clearingAcct.ID, AmountKobo: -amountKobo, Description: \"wallet fund debit provider clearing\", RefType: refType, RefID: refID},\n\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: wallet.ID, AmountKobo: amountKobo, Description: \"wallet fund credit\", RefType: refType, RefID: refID},\n\t}\n\tif err := s.journal(ctx, tx, entries); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tif err := s.adjustBalance(ctx, tx, wallet.ID, amountKobo); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"credit wallet: adjust balance: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// ── Reconciliation & snapshots ───────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n// ReconcileEscrow asserts that the materialised escrow wallet_balance equals\n// the sum of all ledger entries for the escrow account.\n// Returns the drift in kobo (0 = clean). Never auto-corrects.\nfunc (s *LedgerService) ReconcileEscrow(ctx context.Context) (int64, error) {\n\tescrowAcct, err := s.repo.FindPlatformAccount(ctx, model.AccountEscrow)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn 0, fmt.Errorf(\"reconcile: escrow account: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tmaterialised, err := s.repo.GetMaterialisedBalance(ctx, escrowAcct.ID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn 0, fmt.Errorf(\"reconcile: read materialised balance: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tledgerSum, err := s.repo.GetLedgerSum(ctx, escrowAcct.ID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn 0, fmt.Errorf(\"reconcile: ledger sum: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn materialised - ledgerSum, nil\n}\n\n// SnapshotPlatformBalances writes a daily balance snapshot for revenue and\n// provider_clearing accounts. These are aggregate-only (no materialised row),\n// so the snapshot is the only fast historical view.\nfunc (s *LedgerService) SnapshotPlatformBalances(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tfor _, acctType := range []model.AccountType{model.AccountRevenue, model.AccountProviderClearing} {\n\t\tacct, err := s.repo.FindPlatformAccount(ctx, acctType)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"snapshot: %s account: %w\", acctType, err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tsum, err := s.repo.GetLedgerSum(ctx, acct.ID)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"snapshot: sum %s: %w\", acctType, err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tsnap := model.PlatformBalanceSnapshot{\n\t\t\tID:           uuid.New(),\n\t\t\tAccountType:  acctType,\n\t\t\tBalanceKobo:  sum,\n\t\t\tSnapshotDate: time.Now().UTC().Truncate(24 * time.Hour),\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := s.repo.CreateBalanceSnapshot(ctx, &snap); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"snapshot: create %s: %w\", acctType, err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// ── Queries ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nfunc (s *LedgerService) GetBalance(ctx context.Context, userID uuid.UUID) (int64, error) {\n\treturn s.repo.GetBalance(ctx, userID)\n}\n\nfunc (s *LedgerService) GetTransactions(ctx context.Context, userID uuid.UUID, cursor *uuid.UUID, limit int) ([]model.LedgerEntry, error) {\n\treturn s.repo.GetTransactions(ctx, userID, cursor, limit)\n}\n\n// ResolveWalletOwner maps the authenticated caller to the ledger account ID\n// their wallet lives under. That is always their own User.ID: ledger_accounts\n// .owner_id has an FK to users(id), so the ledger is uniformly user-keyed for\n// every role. Merchant settlement reaches the same account by resolving\n// merchants.id -> user_id first (see EnsureMerchantWallet), so no translation\n// is needed on the read path.\n//\n// It is kept as a named seam rather than inlined because the merchant identity\n// split (model.Merchant.ID for the business profile vs User.ID for login) is\n// easy to get backwards; routing every balance read through here keeps the\n// rule stated in one place.\nfunc (s *LedgerService) ResolveWalletOwner(ctx context.Context, userID uuid.UUID, role string) (uuid.UUID, error) {\n\treturn userID, nil\n}\n\n=== Operation 2 Result (Text) ===\npackage service\n\nimport (\n\t\"context\"\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"log/slog\"\n\t\"time\"\n\n\t\"github.com/google/uuid\"\n\t\"github.com/speedplus/api/internal/model\"\n\t\"github.com/speedplus/api/internal/observability\"\n\t\"github.com/speedplus/api/internal/payment\"\n\t\"github.com/speedplus/api/internal/ports\"\n\t\"github.com/speedplus/api/internal/repo\"\n\t\"gorm.io/gorm\"\n\t\"gorm.io/gorm/clause\"\n)\n\ntype WalletService struct {\n\trepo     repo.WalletRepo\n\tledger   *LedgerService\n\tpins     ports.PINVerifier\n\tprovider payment.Provider\n\temail    walletEmailSender\n\tusers    repo.UserRepo\n\tenqueue  func(cashoutID string) error\n}\n\ntype walletEmailSender interface {\n\tSendWalletFunded(ctx context.Context, toEmail, firstName string, amountKobo, newBalanceKobo int64)\n\tSendTransferReceived(ctx context.Context, toEmail, firstName string, amountKobo int64, senderName string)\n}\n\nfunc NewWalletService(r repo.WalletRepo, ledger *LedgerService, pins ports.PINVerifier, provider payment.Provider, email walletEmailSender, users repo.UserRepo) *WalletService {\n\treturn &WalletService{repo: r, ledger: ledger, pins: pins, provider: provider, email: email, users: users}\n}\n\n// InjectQueue wires the asynq enqueue function after construction to avoid a\n// circular dependency. Must be called before any cashout is initiated.\nfunc (s *WalletService) InjectQueue(fn func(cashoutID string) error) {\n\ts.enqueue = fn\n}\n\n// ── Fund wallet (pay-in) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nfunc (s *WalletService) InitiateFund(ctx context.Context, userID uuid.UUID, amountKobo int64, email, idempotencyKey, callbackURL string) (*payment.ChargeResponse, error) {\n\tif existing, err := s.repo.FindPaymentIntentByKey(ctx, idempotencyKey); err == nil {\n\t\treturn &payment.ChargeResponse{Reference: *existing.ProviderRef}, nil\n\t}\n\n\tref := uuid.NewString()\n\tintent := model.PaymentIntent{\n\t\tID:             uuid.New(),\n\t\tUserID:         userID,\n\t\tAmountKobo:     amountKobo,\n\t\tProvider:       s.provider.Name(),\n\t\tStatus:         \"pending\",\n\t\tIdempotencyKey: idempotencyKey,\n\t\tProviderRef:    &ref,\n\t}\n\tif err := s.repo.CreatePaymentIntent(ctx, &intent); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tresp, err := s.provider.InitiateCharge(ctx, payment.ChargeRequest{\n\t\tAmountKobo:  amountKobo,\n\t\tEmail:       email,\n\t\tReference:   ref,\n\t\tCallbackURL: callbackURL,\n\t})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"initiate charge: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn resp, nil\n}\n\n// ── Stablecoin fund via Bridge.xyz ───────────────────────────────────────────\n\n// InitiateCryptoFund creates a Bridge Orchestration payment session so the user\n// can fund their wallet with USDC/USDT. bridge must be a *payment.BridgeProvider.\nfunc (s *WalletService) InitiateCryptoFund(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\tuserID uuid.UUID,\n\tamountKobo int64,\n\temail, fullName, idempotencyKey, callbackURL string,\n\tbridge *payment.BridgeProvider,\n) (*payment.ChargeResponse, error) {\n\tif existing, err := s.repo.FindPaymentIntentByKey(ctx, idempotencyKey); err == nil {\n\t\treturn &payment.ChargeResponse{Reference: *existing.ProviderRef}, nil\n\t}\n\n\twalletID, err := bridge.EnsureWallet(ctx, userID.String(), email, fullName)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"bridge wallet: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tref := uuid.NewString()\n\tintent := model.PaymentIntent{\n\t\tID:             uuid.New(),\n\t\tUserID:         userID,\n\t\tAmountKobo:     amountKobo,\n\t\tProvider:       \"bridge\",\n\t\tStatus:         \"pending\",\n\t\tIdempotencyKey: idempotencyKey,\n\t\tProviderRef:    &ref,\n\t}\n\tif err := s.repo.CreatePaymentIntent(ctx, &intent); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tresp, err := bridge.InitiateCharge(ctx, payment.ChargeRequest{\n\t\tAmountKobo:  amountKobo,\n\t\tEmail:       email,\n\t\tReference:   ref,\n\t\tCallbackURL: callbackURL,\n\t\tMetadata:    map[string]string{\"bridge_wallet_id\": walletID},\n\t})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"bridge charge: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\treturn resp, nil\n}\n\n// ── Webhook processing (dedupe + verify-API call before crediting) ────────────\n\ntype WebhookPayload struct {\n\tProvider  string\n\tEventID   string\n\tEventType string\n\tReference string\n\tRawBody   []byte\n}\n\n// ErrWebhookRetryable signals a transient failure — the handler returns 5xx\n// so the provider retries. Non-retryable outcomes (already processed, unknown\n// reference) return nil so the handler returns 200 and stops retries.\nvar ErrWebhookRetryable = errors.New(\"transient webhook error — retry\")\n\nfunc (s *WalletService) ProcessWebhook(ctx context.Context, p WebhookPayload) error {\n\tvar notify *fundedNotice\n\terr := s.repo.Transaction(ctx, func(tx *gorm.DB) error {\n\t\tif _, err := s.repo.FindWebhookEventTx(ctx, tx, p.Provider, p.EventID); err == nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tnow := time.Now()\n\t\tevent := model.WebhookEvent{\n\t\t\tID:        uuid.New(),\n\t\t\tProvider:  p.Provider,\n\t\t\tEventID:   p.EventID,\n\t\t\tEventType: p.EventType,\n\t\t\tPayload:   string(p.RawBody),\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := s.repo.CreateWebhookEventTx(ctx, tx, &event); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn ErrWebhookRetryable\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif p.EventType != \"charge.success\" && p.EventType != \"transfer.success\" {\n\t\t\treturn nil // non-credit event — 200, no retry needed\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Provider verify-API call — NEVER trust webhook payload alone\n\t\tverified, err := s.provider.VerifyTransaction(ctx, p.Reference)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tobservability.CaptureError(ctx, err, \"webhook: provider verify failed\",\n\t\t\t\t\"provider\", p.Provider, \"reference\", p.Reference)\n\t\t\t// Provider API unreachable — transient, must retry\n\t\t\treturn ErrWebhookRetryable\n\t\t}\n\t\tif verified.Status != \"success\" {\n\t\t\t// Payment genuinely not successful — non-retryable, 200\n\t\t\tobservability.CaptureMessage(ctx, \"webhook: transaction not successful\",\n\t\t\t\t\"provider\", p.Provider, \"reference\", p.Reference, \"status\", verified.Status)\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tintent, err := s.repo.LockPaymentIntentByRefTx(ctx, tx, p.Reference)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif err := s.ledger.CreditWallet(ctx, tx, intent.UserID, verified.AmountKobo, \"payment_intent\", &intent.ID); err != nil {\n\t\t\t// Ledger write failed — transient, must retry\n\t\t\treturn ErrWebhookRetryable\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tintent.Status = \"success\"\n\t\tif err := s.repo.SavePaymentIntentTx(ctx, tx, intent); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn ErrWebhookRetryable\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tevent.ProcessedAt = &now\n\t\tif err := s.repo.SaveWebhookEventTx(ctx, tx, &event); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn ErrWebhookRetryable\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tnewBal, _ := s.ledger.GetBalance(ctx, intent.UserID)\n\t\t// Resolve the recipient here, on the transaction's own connection, and\n\t\t// hand the notifier plain values. The email goroutine must never touch\n\t\t// the database: it would share the connection this transaction is\n\t\t// using, and concurrent use of a single connection panics inside pgx —\n\t\t// a panic in a detached goroutine takes down the whole process.\n\t\tif u, uErr := s.users.FindByID(ctx, intent.UserID); uErr == nil && u.Email != nil {\n\t\t\tnotify = &fundedNotice{\n\t\t\t\temail:     *u.Email,\n\t\t\t\tfirstName: u.FirstName,\n\t\t\t\tuserID:    intent.UserID,\n\t\t\t\tamount:    verified.AmountKobo,\n\t\t\t\tbalance:   newBal,\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treturn nil\n\t})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tif notify != nil {\n\t\ts.sendFundedEmail(*notify)\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// fundedNotice carries everything the wallet-funded email needs, resolved\n// inside the crediting transaction. It holds plain values rather than IDs\n// precisely so the sender never has to query.\ntype fundedNotice struct {\n\temail     string\n\tfirstName string\n\tuserID    uuid.UUID // for log correlation only\n\tamount    int64\n\tbalance   int64\n}\n\n// sendFundedEmail delivers the wallet-funded notification best-effort. It\n// performs no database access — see fundedNotice — and recovers from panics so\n// a notification failure can never take down the API process or affect the\n// already-committed credit.\nfunc (s *WalletService) sendFundedEmail(n fundedNotice) {\n\tgo func() {\n\t\tdefer func() {\n\t\t\tif r := recover(); r != nil {\n\t\t\t\tslog.Error(\"wallet funded email panicked\", \"user_id\", n.userID.String(), \"panic\", r)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}()\n\t\ts.email.SendWalletFunded(context.Background(), n.email, n.firstName, n.amount, n.balance)\n\t}()\n}\n\n// ── Wallet-to-wallet transfer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nfunc (s *WalletService) Transfer(ctx context.Context, senderID, recipientID uuid.UUID, amountKobo int64, pin, idempotencyKey string) error {\n\t// PIN verification\n\tif err := s.pins.VerifyPIN(ctx, senderID, pin); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"pin verification failed\")\n\t}\n\n\t// FIX #2: capture notification data outside the goroutine so the email\n\t// fires after the transaction commits, never inside it.\n\tvar notifyEmail *string\n\tvar notifyFirst, notifySender string\n\n\terr := s.repo.Transaction(ctx, func(tx *gorm.DB) error {\n\t\tif _, err := s.repo.FindIdempotencyKeyTx(ctx, tx, idempotencyKey); err == nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tsenderWallet, err := s.ledger.EnsureWallet(ctx, tx, senderID)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\trecipientWallet, err := s.ledger.EnsureWallet(ctx, tx, recipientID)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tsenderBal, err := s.repo.LockWalletBalanceTx(ctx, tx, senderWallet.ID)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tif senderBal.BalanceKobo < amountKobo {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"%w\", ErrInsufficientBalance)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tjournalID := uuid.New()\n\t\tentries := []model.LedgerEntry{\n\t\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: senderWallet.ID, AmountKobo: -amountKobo, Description: \"wallet transfer out\", RefType: \"transfer\"},\n\t\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: recipientWallet.ID, AmountKobo: amountKobo, Description: \"wallet transfer in\", RefType: \"transfer\"},\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := s.ledger.journal(ctx, tx, entries); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\t// FIX #6: propagate adjustBalance errors — discarding them lets the ledger\n\t\t// and wallet_balances table diverge silently.\n\t\tif err := s.ledger.adjustBalance(ctx, tx, senderWallet.ID, -amountKobo); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"transfer: adjust sender balance: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := s.ledger.adjustBalance(ctx, tx, recipientWallet.ID, amountKobo); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"transfer: adjust recipient balance: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif err := s.repo.CreateIdempotencyKeyTx(ctx, tx, &model.IdempotencyKey{\n\t\t\tKey:       idempotencyKey,\n\t\t\tUserID:    senderID,\n\t\t\tExpiresAt: time.Now().Add(24 * time.Hour),\n\t\t}); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// FIX #2: resolve user details INSIDE the transaction (same connection,\n\t\t// no goroutine) so we hold plain values. Email fires after commit.\n\t\tif sender, sErr := s.users.FindByID(ctx, senderID); sErr == nil {\n\t\t\tif recipient, rErr := s.users.FindByID(ctx, recipientID); rErr == nil && recipient.Email != nil {\n\t\t\t\tnotifyEmail = recipient.Email\n\t\t\t\tnotifyFirst = recipient.FirstName\n\t\t\t\tnotifySender = sender.FirstName + \" \" + sender.LastName\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treturn nil\n\t})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\t// Post-commit: send notification with pre-resolved plain values — no DB access.\n\tif notifyEmail != nil {\n\t\tgo func() {\n\t\t\tdefer func() {\n\t\t\t\tif r := recover(); r != nil {\n\t\t\t\t\tslog.Error(\"transfer email panicked\", \"panic\", r)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}()\n\t\t\ts.email.SendTransferReceived(context.Background(), *notifyEmail, notifyFirst, amountKobo, notifySender)\n\t\t}()\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// ── EWA cashout ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nconst EWACashoutFeeKobo = 10000 // ₦100 instant cashout fee\n\nfunc (s *WalletService) EWACashout(ctx context.Context, driverID uuid.UUID, amountKobo int64, idempotencyKey string) error {\n\terr := s.repo.Transaction(ctx, func(tx *gorm.DB) error {\n\t\tif _, err := s.repo.FindIdempotencyKeyTx(ctx, tx, idempotencyKey); err == nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\n\t\ttotalEarned, err := s.repo.SumUnpaidEarnings(ctx, tx, driverID)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"EWACashout: sum earnings: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif totalEarned < amountKobo+EWACashoutFeeKobo {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"insufficient earned balance\")\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// FIX #1: propagate EnsureWallet / platformAccount errors — discarding\n\t\t// them with _ returns a zero-value struct whose ID is uuid.Nil, causing\n\t\t// every subsequent ledger write to silently corrupt the wrong account.\n\t\tdriverWallet, err := s.ledger.EnsureWallet(ctx, tx, driverID)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"EWACashout: driver wallet: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\trevenueAcct, err := s.ledger.platformAccount(ctx, tx, model.AccountRevenue)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"EWACashout: revenue account: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\t// FIX #5: use an earnings/liability account as the payout pass-through,\n\t\t// not revenue. Revenue should only be recognised as the fee portion.\n\t\t// We reuse AccountEarnings (driver-side liability) as the pass-through\n\t\t// so the net revenue impact is exactly EWACashoutFeeKobo.\n\t\tearningsAcct, err := s.ledger.platformAccount(ctx, tx, model.AccountEarnings)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"EWACashout: earnings account: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tjournalID := uuid.New()\n\t\tentries := []model.LedgerEntry{\n\t\t\t// Debit driver wallet for full amount + fee\n\t\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: driverWallet.ID, AmountKobo: -(amountKobo + EWACashoutFeeKobo), Description: \"EWA cashout debit\", RefType: \"cashout\"},\n\t\t\t// Fee goes to platform revenue\n\t\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: revenueAcct.ID, AmountKobo: EWACashoutFeeKobo, Description: \"EWA cashout fee\", RefType: \"cashout\"},\n\t\t\t// Net payout is a pass-through via earnings until provider confirms\n\t\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: earningsAcct.ID, AmountKobo: amountKobo, Description: \"EWA payout staging\", RefType: \"cashout\"},\n\t\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: earningsAcct.ID, AmountKobo: -amountKobo, Description: \"EWA payout to bank\", RefType: \"cashout\"},\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif err := s.ledger.journal(ctx, tx, entries); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := s.ledger.adjustBalance(ctx, tx, driverWallet.ID, -(amountKobo + EWACashoutFeeKobo)); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"EWACashout: adjust driver balance: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tcashout := model.CashoutRequest{\n\t\t\tID:             uuid.New(),\n\t\t\tDriverID:       driverID,\n\t\t\tAmountKobo:     amountKobo,\n\t\t\tFeeKobo:        EWACashoutFeeKobo,\n\t\t\tStatus:         \"pending\",\n\t\t\tIdempotencyKey: idempotencyKey,\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn s.repo.CreateCashoutTx(ctx, tx, &cashout)\n\t})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tif s.enqueue != nil {\n\t\tif created, err := s.repo.FindCashoutByKey(ctx, idempotencyKey); err == nil {\n\t\t\tif enqErr := s.enqueue(created.ID.String()); enqErr != nil {\n\t\t\t\tobservability.CaptureError(ctx, enqErr, \"EWACashout: enqueue failed\", \"idempotency_key\", idempotencyKey)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// ── Weekly auto-payout (called by asynq cron) ─────────────────────────────────\n\nfunc (s *WalletService) WeeklyAutoPayout(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tdrivers, _ := s.repo.ListDriversWithUnpaidEarnings(ctx)\n\n\tfor _, driverID := range drivers {\n\t\ttotal, err := s.repo.SumUnpaidEarnings(ctx, nil, driverID)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tobservability.CaptureError(ctx, err, \"weekly payout: sum earnings\", \"driver_id\", driverID.String())\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif total <= 0 {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tkey := fmt.Sprintf(\"weekly-payout:%s:%s\", driverID, time.Now().Format(\"2006-W01\"))\n\t\tif err := s.EWACashout(ctx, driverID, total, key); err != nil {\n\t\t\tobservability.CaptureError(ctx, err, \"weekly payout failed\", \"driver_id\", driverID.String())\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// ── Merchant withdrawal ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nconst (\n\t// MerchantWithdrawMinKobo is the minimum withdrawal amount (₦1,000).\n\tMerchantWithdrawMinKobo = 100_000\n\t// MerchantInstantFeePct is the fee rate for instant withdrawals (1%).\n\tMerchantInstantFeePct = 0.01\n\t// MerchantInstantFeeMinKobo is the minimum instant fee (₦10 — covers provider cost).\n\tMerchantInstantFeeMinKobo = 1_000\n\t// MerchantInstantFeeMaxKobo caps the instant fee at ₦500.\n\tMerchantInstantFeeMaxKobo = 50_000\n)\n\n// merchantInstantFee computes the 1% instant withdrawal fee, clamped to [min, max].\nfunc merchantInstantFee(amountKobo int64) int64 {\n\tfee := int64(float64(amountKobo) * MerchantInstantFeePct)\n\tif fee < MerchantInstantFeeMinKobo {\n\t\treturn MerchantInstantFeeMinKobo\n\t}\n\tif fee > MerchantInstantFeeMaxKobo {\n\t\treturn MerchantInstantFeeMaxKobo\n\t}\n\treturn fee\n}\n\n// MerchantWithdraw debits the merchant's wallet and enqueues a bank transfer.\n// withdrawalType must be \"instant\" or \"standard\".\n// - standard: free, batched daily at 18:00 WAT.\n// - instant: 1% fee (min ₦10, max ₦500), processed within minutes.\n// PIN is verified before any money moves. The actual provider transfer is\n// dispatched by the asynq worker (TaskCashoutProcess).\nfunc (s *WalletService) MerchantWithdraw(ctx context.Context, merchantID uuid.UUID, userID uuid.UUID, amountKobo int64, pin, idempotencyKey, withdrawalType string) error {\n\tif amountKobo < MerchantWithdrawMinKobo {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"minimum withdrawal is %s\", formatKobo(MerchantWithdrawMinKobo))\n\t}\n\tif withdrawalType != \"instant\" && withdrawalType != \"standard\" {\n\t\twithdrawalType = \"standard\"\n\t}\n\n\t// PIN verification — uses the merchant's login User.ID (PIN is on the user row)\n\tif err := s.pins.VerifyPIN(ctx, userID, pin); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"pin verification failed\")\n\t}\n\n\terr := s.repo.Transaction(ctx, func(tx *gorm.DB) error {\n\t\tif _, err := s.repo.FindIdempotencyKeyTx(ctx, tx, idempotencyKey); err == nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tbankAcct, err := s.repo.FindMerchantBankAccountTx(ctx, tx, merchantID)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"no verified bank account on file — add one before withdrawing\")\n\t\t}\n\t\t_ = bankAcct\n\n\t\tvar feeKobo int64\n\t\tif withdrawalType == \"instant\" {\n\t\t\tfeeKobo = merchantInstantFee(amountKobo)\n\t\t}\n\t\ttotalDebit := amountKobo + feeKobo\n\n\t\t// FIX #4: use EnsureMerchantWallet which resolves merchants.id → user_id\n\t\t// before touching ledger_accounts. Passing merchantID directly violates\n\t\t// the FK on ledger_accounts.owner_id → users(id).\n\t\tmerchantWallet, err := s.ledger.EnsureMerchantWallet(ctx, tx, merchantID)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tvar bal model.WalletBalance\n\t\tif err := tx.Clauses(clause.Locking{Strength: \"UPDATE\"}).\n\t\t\tWhere(\"account_id = ?\", merchantWallet.ID).First(&bal).Error; err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tif bal.BalanceKobo < totalDebit {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"%w: have %s, need %s\",\n\t\t\t\tErrInsufficientBalance, formatKobo(bal.BalanceKobo), formatKobo(totalDebit))\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Debit merchant wallet; fee (if any) goes to platform revenue.\n\t\t// Net payout amount is held in revenue as a pass-through until the\n\t\t// worker confirms the provider transfer.\n\t\trevenueAcct, err := s.ledger.platformAccount(ctx, tx, model.AccountRevenue)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"revenue account: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tjournalID := uuid.New()\n\t\tentries := []model.LedgerEntry{\n\t\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: merchantWallet.ID,\n\t\t\t\tAmountKobo:  -totalDebit,\n\t\t\t\tDescription: fmt.Sprintf(\"merchant %s withdrawal debit\", withdrawalType), RefType: \"cashout\"},\n\t\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: revenueAcct.ID,\n\t\t\t\tAmountKobo:  feeKobo,\n\t\t\t\tDescription: fmt.Sprintf(\"merchant %s withdrawal fee\", withdrawalType), RefType: \"cashout\"},\n\t\t\t// Net payout: revenue is pass-through, balanced when provider confirms transfer.\n\t\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: revenueAcct.ID,\n\t\t\t\tAmountKobo:  -amountKobo,\n\t\t\t\tDescription: \"merchant payout to bank\", RefType: \"cashout\"},\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := s.ledger.journal(ctx, tx, entries); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := s.ledger.adjustBalance(ctx, tx, merchantWallet.ID, -totalDebit); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"adjust merchant balance: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tcashout := model.CashoutRequest{\n\t\t\tID:             uuid.New(),\n\t\t\tDriverID:       uuid.Nil,\n\t\t\tMerchantID:     &merchantID,\n\t\t\tActorType:      \"merchant\",\n\t\t\tAmountKobo:     amountKobo,\n\t\t\tFeeKobo:        feeKobo,\n\t\t\tStatus:         \"pending\",\n\t\t\tIdempotencyKey: idempotencyKey,\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn s.repo.CreateCashoutTx(ctx, tx, &cashout)\n\t})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tif s.enqueue != nil {\n\t\tif created, err := s.repo.FindCashoutByKey(ctx, idempotencyKey); err == nil && withdrawalType == \"instant\" {\n\t\t\tif enqErr := s.enqueue(created.ID.String()); enqErr != nil {\n\t\t\t\tobservability.CaptureError(ctx, enqErr, \"MerchantWithdraw: enqueue failed\", \"idempotency_key\", idempotencyKey)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// ReverseCashout credits the wallet back when a provider transfer fails permanently.\n// Called by the worker after all retries are exhausted.\nfunc (s *WalletService) ReverseCashout(ctx context.Context, cashout *model.CashoutRequest) error {\n\treturn s.repo.Transaction(ctx, func(tx *gorm.DB) error {\n\t\t// Determine which wallet to credit back\n\t\tvar ownerID uuid.UUID\n\t\tif cashout.ActorType == \"merchant\" && cashout.MerchantID != nil {\n\t\t\townerID = *cashout.MerchantID\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\townerID = cashout.DriverID\n\t\t}\n\n\t\twallet, err := s.ledger.EnsureWallet(ctx, tx, ownerID)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"reverse cashout: wallet: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\trevenueAcct, err := s.ledger.platformAccount(ctx, tx, model.AccountRevenue)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"reverse cashout: revenue account: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// Reverse the original debit: credit wallet back (amount + fee),\n\t\t// debit revenue to unwind both the fee credit and the payout pass-through.\n\t\ttotalCredit := cashout.AmountKobo + cashout.FeeKobo\n\t\tjournalID := uuid.New()\n\t\tentries := []model.LedgerEntry{\n\t\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: wallet.ID,\n\t\t\t\tAmountKobo:  totalCredit,\n\t\t\t\tDescription: \"cashout reversal — transfer failed\", RefType: \"cashout\", RefID: &cashout.ID},\n\t\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: revenueAcct.ID,\n\t\t\t\tAmountKobo:  -totalCredit,\n\t\t\t\tDescription: \"cashout reversal — unwind revenue\", RefType: \"cashout\", RefID: &cashout.ID},\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := s.ledger.journal(ctx, tx, entries); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := s.ledger.adjustBalance(ctx, tx, wallet.ID, totalCredit); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"reverse cashout: adjust balance: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tcashout.Status = \"failed\"\n\t\treturn s.repo.SaveCashoutTx(ctx, tx, cashout)\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (s *WalletService) DB() *gorm.DB               { return nil }\nfunc (s *WalletService) Provider() payment.Provider { return s.provider }\n\nfunc (s *WalletService) ResolveCashoutRecipient(ctx context.Context, cashout *model.CashoutRequest) (recipientCode, accountName, reason string, err error) {\n\tif cashout.ActorType == \"merchant\" && cashout.MerchantID != nil {\n\t\tbankAcct, err := s.repo.FindMerchantBankAccountTx(ctx, nil, *cashout.MerchantID)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn \"\", \"\", \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"merchant bank account: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif s.provider.Name() == \"monnify\" {\n\t\t\treturn bankAcct.BankCode + \":\" + bankAcct.AccountNumber, bankAcct.AccountName, \"SpeedPlus merchant payout\", nil\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn bankAcct.AccountNumber, bankAcct.AccountName, \"SpeedPlus merchant payout\", nil\n\t}\n\treturn \"\", \"\", \"\", fmt.Errorf(\"driver bank account resolution not yet implemented\")\n}\n\nfunc formatKobo(k int64) string {\n\ts := fmt.Sprintf(\"%d\", k/100)\n\tout := \"\"\n\tfor i, ch := range s {\n\t\tif i > 0 && (len(s)-i)%3 == 0 {\n\t\t\tout += \",\"\n\t\t}\n\t\tout += string(ch)\n\t}\n\treturn \"₦\" + out\n}"

(\n\tErrIllegalTransition    = errors.New(\"illegal order state transition\")\n\tErrQuoteInvalid         = errors.New(\"quote invalid or expired\")\n\tErrMerchantClosed       = errors.New(\"merchant balance\")\n)\n\ntype CreateOrderInput struct {\n\tCustomerID        uuid.UUID\n\tMerchantID        uuid.UUID\n\tQuoteID           uuid.UUID\n\tVertical          string\n\tItems             []OrderItemInput\n\tDeliveryAddrID    uuid.UUID\n\tRecipientName     *string\n\tRecipientPhone    *string\n\tPrescriptionID    *uuid.UUID\n\tTipKobo           int64\n\tScheduledFor      *time.Time\n\tPaymentMethod     string\n\tDeclaredValueKobo *int64\n\tIdempotencyKey    string\n\tStops             []OrderStopInput\n\t// Gas-specific (Phase 1)\n\tGasMode    *string    // swap|refill|new_cylinder\n\tCylinderID *uuid.UUID // refill mode: customer's registered cylinder\n}\n\ntype OrderStopInput struct {\n\tSequence       int\n\tAddressID      uuid.UUID\n\tRecipientName int64\n\tWeightKg         float64\n\tSizeCategory     string\n\tCustomizations   *string\n\tSubstitutionPref *string\n}\n\ntype OrderService struct {\n\torders        repo.OrderRepo\n\tpricing       *PricingService\n\tledger        *LedgerService\n\ttier          *TierService\n\tdispatch      *DispatchService\n\thub           wsPublisher\n\tdeliveryCodes *DeliveryCodeService\n\trecipients
