      "assistant": {
        "ToolUse": {
          "message_id": "3f298163-69ad-4bb3-af51-669861cbde33",
          "content": "The wallet handler already has the right structure. Add the three driver bank account handlers as a new file to keep things clean:",
          "tool_uses": [
            {
              "id": "tooluse_5zQV6nOvI8MMyVfl4w2KEV",
              "name": "fs_write",
              "orig_name": "fs_write",
              "args": {
                "command": "create",
                "file_text": "package handler\n\nimport (\n\t\"net/http\"\n\n\t\"github.com/gin-gonic/gin\"\n\t\"github.com/google/uuid\"\n\t\"github.com/speedplus/api/internal/middleware\"\n\t\"github.com/speedplus/api/internal/service\"\n)\n\n// DriverBankHandler handles driver bank account management.\n// All routes require role=driver.\ntype DriverBankHandler struct {\n\twallet *service.WalletService\n}\n\nfunc NewDriverBankHandler(wallet *service.WalletService) *DriverBankHandler {\n\treturn &DriverBankHandler{wallet: wallet}\n}\n\n// ResolveAccount — POST /driver/bank-account/resolve\n// Calls Paystack to verify the account number and return the authoritative name.\n// The client shows this name to the driver for confirmation before saving.\nfunc (h *DriverBankHandler) ResolveAccount(c *gin.Context) {\n\tvar req struct {\n\t\tBankCode      string `json:\"bankCode\"      binding:\"required\"`\n\t\tAccountNumber string `json:\"accountNumber\" binding:\"required\"`\n\t}\n\tif err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {\n\t\tvalidationError(c, err)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tname, err := h.wallet.ResolveDriverBankAccount(c.Request.Context(), req.BankCode, req.AccountNumber)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tc.JSON(http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, errResp(\"VALIDATION_ERROR\", \"Could not verify account — check the account number and bank code\", \"accountNumber\"))\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.JSON(http.StatusOK, successResp(gin.H{\"accountName\": name}))\n}\n\n// SaveAccount — POST /driver/bank-account\n// Resolves the account name server-side (ignores any client-supplied name),\n// then persists the verified account.\nfunc (h *DriverBankHandler) SaveAccount(c *gin.Context) {\n\tvar req struct {\n\t\tBankCode      string `json:\"bankCode\"      binding:\"required\"`\n\t\tBankName      string `json:\"bankName\"      binding:\"required\"`\n\t\tAccountNumber string `json:\"accountNumber\" binding:\"required\"`\n\t}\n\tif err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {\n\t\tvalidationError(c, err)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tdriverID, _ := uuid.Parse(c.GetString(middleware.CtxUserID))\n\n\t// Always resolve server-side — never trust a name from the request body.\n\tresolvedName, err := h.wallet.ResolveDriverBankAccount(c.Request.Context(), req.BankCode, req.AccountNumber)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tc.JSON(http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, errResp(\"VALIDATION_ERROR\", \"Could not verify account — check the account number and bank code\", \"accountNumber\"))\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tacct, err := h.wallet.SaveDriverBankAccount(c.Request.Context(), driverID, req.BankCode, req.BankName, req.AccountNumber, resolvedName)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tinternalError(c, err)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.JSON(http.StatusOK, successResp(gin.H{\n\t\t\"bankCode\":      acct.BankCode,\n\t\t\"bankName\":      acct.BankName,\n\t\t\"accountNumber\": acct.AccountNumber,\n\t\t\"accountName\":   acct.AccountName,\n\t}))\n}\n\n// GetAccount — GET /driver/bank-account\nfunc (h *DriverBankHandler) GetAccount(c *gin.Context) {\n\tdriverID, _ := uuid.Parse(c.GetString(middleware.CtxUserID))\n\tacct, err := h.wallet.GetDriverBankAccount(c.Request.Context(), driverID)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tinternalError(c, err)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif acct == nil {\n\t\tc.JSON(http.StatusOK, successResp(nil))\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.JSON(http.StatusOK, successResp(gin.H{\n\t\t\"bankCode\":      acct.BankCode,\n\t\t\"bankName\":      acct.BankName,\n\t\t\"accountNumber\": acct.AccountNumber,\n\t\t\"accountName\":   acct.AccountName,\n\t}))\n}\n",

      "assistant": {
        "ToolUse": {
          "message_id": "be840d9e-4ec4-4c26-aa13-d70a974d6757",
          "content": "## 12. Rate limiter: fail closed for auth/otp",
          "tool_uses": [
            {
              "id": "tooluse_Xu6rRjMJSKyuQNNWsm2yWK",
              "name": "fs_write",
              "orig_name": "fs_write",
              "args": {
                "command": "str_replace",
                "new_str": "// RateLimit returns a fixed-window limiter: `limit` requests per `window`.\n// Key is scoped to IP + routeKey so /auth/* and /otp/* can have tighter limits.\n// failClosed: when true, a Redis error returns 503 instead of allowing the request.\n// Set failClosed=true for auth/OTP endpoints to prevent brute-force during Redis outages.\nfunc RateLimit(rdb *redis.Client, routeKey string, limit int, window time.Duration, failClosed ...bool) gin.HandlerFunc {\n\tclosed := len(failClosed) > 0 && failClosed[0]\n\treturn func(c *gin.Context) {\n\t\tkey := fmt.Sprintf(\"rl:%s:%s\", routeKey, c.ClientIP())\n\t\tctx := c.Request.Context()\n\n\t\tcount, err := rdb.Incr(ctx, key).Result()\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tif closed {\n\t\t\t\tc.AbortWithStatusJSON(http.StatusServiceUnavailable, gin.H{\n\t\t\t\t\t\"error\": gin.H{\"code\": \"SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE\", \"message\": \"Service temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.\"},\n\t\t\t\t})\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t// fail open for non-critical endpoints\n\t\t\tc.Next()\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tif count == 1 {\n\t\t\trdb.Expire(ctx, key, window)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tc.Header(\"X-RateLimit-Limit\", fmt.Sprintf(\"%d\", limit))\n\t\tremaining := int64(limit) - count\n\t\tif remaining < 0 {\n\t\t\tremaining = 0\n\t\t}\n\t\tc.Header(\"X-RateLimit-Remaining\", fmt.Sprintf(\"%d\", remaining))\n\n\t\tif count > int64(limit) {\n\t\t\tttl, _ := rdb.TTL(ctx, key).Result()\n\t\t\tif ttl > 0 {\n\t\t\t\tc.Header(\"Retry-After\", fmt.Sprintf(\"%.0f\", ttl.Seconds()))\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tc.AbortWithStatusJSON(http.StatusTooManyRequests, gin.H{\n\t\t\t\t\"error\": gin.H{\n\t\t\t\t\t\"code\":    \"RATE_LIMITED\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\"message\": \"Too many requests. Please slow down.\",\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tc.Next()\n\t}\n}",

                "new_str": "// OperationalMetrics is the daily business health snapshot for the admin dashboard.\ntype OperationalMetrics struct {\n\tOrdersToday      int64   `json:\"ordersToday\"`\n\tGMVKobo          int64   `json:\"gmvKobo\"`           // gross merchandise value (sum of order totals)\n\tRevenueKobo      int64   `json:\"revenueKobo\"`       // platform revenue (service fees + delivery margin)\n\tActiveDrivers    int64   `json:\"activeDrivers\"`     // drivers online right now\n\tActiveMerchants  int64   `json:\"activeMerchants\"`   // merchants currently open\n\tFailedPayments   int64   `json:\"failedPayments\"`    // payment intents failed today\n\tCancellations    int64   `json:\"cancellations\"`     // orders cancelled today\n\tCancellationRate float64 `json:\"cancellationRate\"`  // cancellations / total orders today\n}\n\nfunc (r *adminRepo) GetMetrics(ctx context.Context) (*OperationalMetrics, error) {\n\tm := &OperationalMetrics{}\n\ttoday := \"created_at >= CURRENT_DATE\"\n\n\tif err := r.db.WithContext(ctx).Model(&model.Order{}).\n\t\tWhere(today).Count(&m.OrdersToday).Error; err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tif err := r.db.WithContext(ctx).Model(&model.Order{}).\n\t\tWhere(today+\" AND status != 'cancelled'\").\n\t\tSelect(\"COALESCE(SUM(total_kobo), 0)\").Scan(&m.GMVKobo).Error; err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tif err := r.db.WithContext(ctx).Model(&model.Order{}).\n\t\tWhere(today+\" AND status != 'cancelled'\").\n\t\tSelect(\"COALESCE(SUM(service_kobo), 0)\").Scan(&m.RevenueKobo).Error; err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tif err := r.db.WithContext(ctx).Model(&model.DriverProfile{}).\n\t\tWhere(\"is_online = true\").Count(&m.ActiveDrivers).Error; err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tif err := r.db.WithContext(ctx).Model(&model.Merchant{}).\n\t\tWhere(\"is_open = true\").Count(&m.ActiveMerchants).Error; err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tif err := r.db.WithContext(ctx).Model(&model.PaymentIntent{}).\n\t\tWhere(today+\" AND status = 'failed'\").Count(&m.FailedPayments).Error; err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tif err := r.db.WithContext(ctx).Model(&model.Order{}).\n\t\tWhere(today+\" AND status = 'cancelled'\").Count(&m.Cancellations).Error; err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tif m.OrdersToday > 0 {\n\t\tm.CancellationRate = float64(m.Cancellations) / float64(m.OrdersToday)\n\t}\n\treturn m, nil\n}",

                "file_text": "import { apiClient } from '../client';\nimport type { ApiResponse } from '@speedplus/types';\n\nexport interface DriverBankAccount {\n  bankCode: string;\n  bankName: string;\n  accountNumber: string;\n  accountName: string;\n}\n\nexport const earningsApi = {\n  async cashout(amountKobo: number, idempotencyKey: string) {\n    const { data } = await apiClient.post<ApiResponse<{ message: string }>>(\n      '/earnings/cashout',\n      { amountKobo },\n      { headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': idempotencyKey } },\n    );\n    if (!data.success) throw new Error(data.error.message);\n    return data.data;\n  },\n\n  async getBankAccount(): Promise<DriverBankAccount | null> {\n    const { data } = await apiClient.get<ApiResponse<DriverBankAccount | null>>('/drivers/bank-account');\n    if (!data.success) throw new Error(data.error.message);\n    return data.data;\n  },\n\n  async resolveAccount(bankCode: string, accountNumber: string): Promise<{ accountName: string }> {\n    const { data } = await apiClient.post<ApiResponse<{ accountName: string }>>(\n      '/drivers/bank-account/resolve',\n      { bankCode, accountNumber },\n    );\n    if (!data.success) throw new Error(data.error.message);\n    return data.data;\n  },\n\n  async saveBankAccount(input: { bankCode: string; bankName: string; accountNumber: string }): Promise<DriverBankAccount> {\n    const { data } = await apiClient.post<ApiResponse<DriverBankAccount>>('/drivers/bank-account', input);\n    if (!data.success) throw new Error(data.error.message);\n    return data.data;\n  },\n};\n",

                "file_text": "import { apiClient } from '../client';\nimport type { ApiResponse } from '@speedplus/types';\n\nexport interface DriverBankAccount {\n  bankCode: string;\n  bankName: string;\n  accountNumber: string;\n  accountName: string;\n}\n\nexport const earningsApi = {\n  async cashout(amountKobo: number, idempotencyKey: string) {\n    const { data } = await apiClient.post<ApiResponse<{ message: string }>>(\n      '/earnings/cashout',\n      { amountKobo },\n      { headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': idempotencyKey } },\n    );\n    if (!data.success) throw new Error(data.error.message);\n    return data.data;\n  },\n\n  async getBankAccount(): Promise<DriverBankAccount | null> {\n    const { data } = await apiClient.get<ApiResponse<DriverBankAccount | null>>('/drivers/bank-account');\n    if (!data.success) throw new Error(data.error.message);\n    return data.data;\n  },\n\n  async resolveAccount(bankCode: string, accountNumber: string): Promise<{ accountName: string }> {\n    const { data } = await apiClient.post<ApiResponse<{ accountName: string }>>(\n      '/drivers/bank-account/resolve',\n      { bankCode, accountNumber },\n    );\n    if (!data.success) throw new Error(data.error.message);\n    return data.data;\n  },\n\n  async saveBankAccount(input: { bankCode: string; bankName: string; accountNumber: string }): Promise<DriverBankAccount> {\n    const { data } = await apiClient.post<ApiResponse<DriverBankAccount>>('/drivers/bank-account', input);\n    if (!data.success) throw new Error(data.error.message);\n    return data.data;\n  },\n};\n",

          "content": "All tests pass. Here's a complete summary of everything that was built.\n\n---\n\n## Sprint 1 — Complete\n\nEvery item verified against the actual codebase before writing a line. Here's what landed:\n\n### P0 — Driver payouts (broken → working)\n\n**Migration 035** — `driver_bank_accounts` table + `failed_attempts`/`locked_until` columns on `pins`.\n\n**`DriverBankAccount` model** — mirrors `MerchantBankAccount`, added to `model/user.go`.\n\n**`UserRepo`** — 4 new methods: `IncrementPINFailure`, `ResetPINFailures`, `FindDriverBankAccount`, `UpsertDriverBankAccount`.\n\n**`WalletRepo`** — `FindDriverBankAccountTx` added.\n\n**`WalletService`** — `ResolveCashoutRecipient` now has a real driver path. `ResolveDriverBankAccount`, `SaveDriverBankAccount`, `GetDriverBankAccount` added.\n\n**`handler/driver_bank.go`** — 3 endpoints: `POST /drivers/bank-account/resolve`, `POST /drivers/bank-account`, `GET /drivers/bank-account`. Server-side resolution only — client-supplied account names are ignored.\n\n**Routes wired** in `main.go` under the existing `drivers` group.\n\n### P0 — Bank verification now server-side (merchants + drivers)\n\n**`PaystackProvider.ResolveAccount`** — calls `/bank/resolve`, returns authoritative name.\n\n**`MerchantHandler.SaveBankAccount`** — no longer accepts `accountName` from the request body. Calls `ResolveDriverBankAccount` internally before saving.\n\n### P0 — PIN brute-force protection\n\n**`AuthService.VerifyPIN`** — 5 failures → 30-minute lockout. Success resets counter. Lock checked before bcrypt (fast path).\n\n**`PaycodeService.ConfirmByCard`** — same lockout logic applied inline (avoids circular dep with AuthService).\n\n### P0 — Customer support path\n\n**`apps/customer/app/orders/page.tsx`** — \"Report issue\" button on every active order. Tapping it opens a modal with 6 issue categories. Selecting one opens a pre-filled WhatsApp message with the order ID and issue type. Zero backend required for the pilot.\n\n### P1 — Rate limiter fail-closed for auth/OTP\n\n**`middleware/ratelimit.go`** — variadic `failClosed bool` parameter. Auth and OTP groups now pass `true` — Redis outage returns 503 instead of allowing unlimited requests.\n\n### P1 — Admin operational metrics\n\n**`repo/admin.go`** — `GetMetrics` runs 7 targeted queries: orders today, GMV, revenue, active drivers, active merchants, failed payments, cancellations + rate.\n\n**`service/admin.go`** — `GetMetrics` delegates to repo.\n\n**`handler/admin.go`** — `GET /admin/metrics` endpoint.\n\n**`apps/admin/app/metrics/page.tsx`** — clean dashboard with 7 stat cards, auto-refreshes every 60 seconds.\n\n**Admin root** now redirects to `/metrics` instead of `/kyc`.\n\n### P1 — Secrets cleanup\n\n**`.env`** — leaked Sendbyte key removed. `ENCRYPTION_KEY`, `PAYCODE_SECRET`, `QUOTE_SECRET` placeholders added with generation instructions.\n\n### Driver app UX\n\n**`packages/api-client/src/endpoints/earnings.ts`** — `getBankAccount`, `resolveAccount`, `saveBankAccount` added.\n\n**`apps/driver/app/page.tsx`** — Earn tab now shows bank account status. If no account is saved, cashout button is disabled with a clear message. Bank account form: enter bank code + account number → \"Verify account\" calls the backend → shows provider-resolved name → \"Save account\" confirms. Cashout is blocked until a verified account exists."
        }

            "prompt": "I reviewed the implementation summary. The AI agent did a decent amount of work and the backend verification is a good sign (`go build ./...` and `go test ./...` passing), but before calling Sprint 1 complete, I would not merge this yet. There are several production issues and security gaps to resolve.\n\n## Critical issues to fix before merge\n\n### 1. WhatsApp support number is still fake\n\nCurrent:\n\n```ts\nwindow.open(`https://wa.me/2348000000000?text=${msg}`, '_blank');\n```\n\nThis is a placeholder. In production this silently sends users nowhere useful.\n\nFix:\n\n* Move support number to environment variable.\n\nExample:\n\n```env\nNEXT_PUBLIC_SUPPORT_WHATSAPP=234XXXXXXXXXX\n```\n\nThen:\n\n```ts\nconst supportNumber = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPPORT_WHATSAPP;\n\nwindow.open(\n  `https://wa.me/${supportNumber}?text=${msg}`,\n  '_blank'\n);\n```\n\nReason:\n\n* Avoids code changes when support number changes.\n* Different numbers for staging/production.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Driver bank account flow leaks sensitive banking data\n\nCurrent UI:\n\n```tsx\n{bankAccount.bankName} · {bankAccount.accountNumber}\n```\n\nYou should not show the full account number.\n\nChange:\n\n```tsx\n{bankAccount.bankName} · ****{bankAccount.accountNumber.slice(-4)}\n```\n\nReason:\n\n* If driver phone is compromised, attacker gets payout information.\n* Standard fintech behaviour is masked account numbers.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Bank code input is too manual\n\nCurrent:\n\n```\nBank code (e.g. 058 for GTBank)\n```\n\nThis creates support issues.\n\nDrivers will enter:\n\n* GTBank\n* Gt bank\n* 58\n* 058\n* Guaranty Trust\n\nBetter:\n\nBackend endpoint:\n\n```\nGET /banks\n```\n\nReturns:\n\n```json\n[\n {\n   \"code\":\"058\",\n   \"name\":\"Guaranty Trust Bank\"\n }\n]\n```\n\nFrontend:\n\nDropdown:\n\n```\nSelect bank\n↓\nGTBank\nAccess Bank\nFirst Bank\n...\n```\n\nReason:\n\n* Removes human error.\n* Paystack already provides bank lists.\n\n---\n\n## 4. Account verification needs rate limiting\n\nEndpoint:\n\n```\nPOST /drivers/bank-account/resolve\n```\n\nCurrently a driver can spam Paystack resolution.\n\nAdd:\n\n```\n5 requests/minute/user\n```\n\nReason:\n\n* Prevent Paystack API abuse.\n* Reduce unnecessary costs.\n\n---\n\n## 5. Cashout flow has a race condition\n\nCurrent:\n\n```tsx\ndisabled={!walletData?.balanceKobo || !bankAccount}\n```\n\nFrontend blocking is not enough.\n\nSomeone can call:\n\n```\nPOST /earnings/cashout\n```\n\ndirectly.\n\nBackend must verify:\n\n```go\nif driver.BankAccount == nil {\n    return ErrBankAccountRequired\n}\n```\n\ninside cashout service.\n\nReason:\nFrontend restrictions are never security controls.\n\n---\n\n# Admin metrics issues\n\n## 6. Metrics endpoint needs authorization verification\n\nConfirm:\n\n```\nGET /admin/metrics\n```\n\nhas:\n\n* admin role middleware\n* permission check\n\nNot just authenticated user.\n\nExample:\n\n```go\nRequireRole(\"admin\")\n```\n\nOtherwise any merchant/driver token could see:\n\n* GMV\n* revenue\n* active drivers\n* failed payments\n\n---\n\n## 7. Metrics queries need indexes\n\nYou added:\n\n* orders today\n* GMV\n* revenue\n* cancellations\n\nCheck indexes exist.\n\nLikely needed:\n\n```sql\nCREATE INDEX idx_orders_created_at\nON orders(created_at);\n\n\nCREATE INDEX idx_orders_status_created_at\nON orders(status, created_at);\n\n\nCREATE INDEX idx_payments_status_created_at\nON payments(status, created_at);\n```\n\nReason:\n\nAt 100k+ orders/day these dashboard queries will become expensive.\n\n---\n\n# PIN security\n\nGood implementation overall.\n\nBut this:\n\n```go\nreturn fmt.Errorf(\"pin locked — too many failed attempts, try again after %s\",\npinModel.LockedUntil.Format(\"15:04\"))\n```\n\nLeaks lock timing.\n\nBetter:\n\n```\nreturn errors.New(\"PIN temporarily locked. Try again later\")\n```\n\nReason:\nMinor information leakage.\n\n---\n\n# Customer support flow\n\nThe idea is good for MVP.\n\nHowever, add:\n\n```\nIssue ID\n```\n\nExample WhatsApp:\n\n```\nHello SpeedPlus Support\n\nOrder: #AB12345\nIssue: Missing item\n\nReference:\nSUP-20260731-93821\n```\n\nReason:\nSupport can track cases.\n\n---\n\n# Missing tests\n\nBackend tests passed, but there are no tests mentioned for:\n\n### Bank account\n\nNeed:\n\n```\nTestResolveDriverBankAccount\nTestSaveDriverBankAccount\nTestCashoutWithoutBankAccount\n```\n\n### PIN\n\nNeed:\n\n```\nTestPINLocksAfterFiveFailures\nTestPINUnlockAfter30Minutes\nTestSuccessfulPINResetsCounter\n```\n\n### Metrics\n\nNeed:\n\n```\nTestAdminMetricsRequiresAdminRole\n```\n\n---\n\n# Frontend checks\n\nNeed to run:\n\n```bash\npnpm lint\npnpm typecheck\npnpm build\n```\n\nfor:\n\n* apps/admin\n* apps/customer\n* apps/driver\n\nGo passing does not guarantee Next.js compilation.\n\n---\n\n# Architecture recommendation\n\nFor Sprint 1, I would accept the direction but make these changes:\n\n| Priority | Fix                                         |\n| -------- | ------------------------------------------- |\n| P0       | Replace WhatsApp placeholder                |\n| P0       | Backend enforce bank account before cashout |\n| P0       | Hide account numbers                        |\n| P0       | Verify admin authorization                  |\n| P1       | Bank dropdown instead of manual codes       |\n| P1       | Add bank resolve rate limit                 |\n| P1       | Add DB indexes                              |\n| P2       | Add automated tests                         |\n\nAfter these, Sprint 1 is realistically production-ready for a Nigerian logistics MVP.\n"
          }
        },

                      "stdout": "func (s *WalletService) EWACashout(ctx context.Context, driverID uuid.UUID, amountKobo int64, idempotencyKey string) error {\n\terr := s.repo.Transaction(ctx, func(tx *gorm.DB) error {\n\t\tif _, err := s.repo.FindIdempotencyKeyTx(ctx, tx, idempotencyKey); err == nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\n\t\ttotalEarned, err := s.repo.SumUnpaidEarnings(ctx, tx, driverID)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"EWACashout: sum earnings: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif totalEarned < amountKobo+EWACashoutFeeKobo {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"insufficient earned balance\")\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// FIX #1: propagate EnsureWallet / platformAccount errors — discarding\n\t\t// them with _ returns a zero-value struct whose ID is uuid.Nil, causing\n\t\t// every subsequent ledger write to silently corrupt the wrong account.\n\t\tdriverWallet, err := s.ledger.EnsureWallet(ctx, tx, driverID)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"EWACashout: driver wallet: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\trevenueAcct, err := s.ledger.platformAccount(ctx, tx, model.AccountRevenue)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"EWACashout: revenue account: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\t// FIX #5: use an earnings/liability account as the payout pass-through,\n\t\t// not revenue. Revenue should only be recognised as the fee portion.\n\t\t// We reuse AccountEarnings (driver-side liability) as the pass-through\n\t\t// so the net revenue impact is exactly EWACashoutFeeKobo.\n\t\tearningsAcct, err := s.ledger.platformAccount(ctx, tx, model.AccountEarnings)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"EWACashout: earnings account: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tjournalID := uuid.New()\n\t\tentries := []model.LedgerEntry{\n\t\t\t// Debit driver wallet for full amount + fee\n\t\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: driverWallet.ID, AmountKobo: -(amountKobo + EWACashoutFeeKobo), Description: \"EWA cashout debit\", RefType: \"cashout\"},\n\t\t\t// Fee goes to platform revenue\n\t\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: revenueAcct.ID, AmountKobo: EWACashoutFeeKobo, Description: \"EWA cashout fee\", RefType: \"cashout\"},\n\t\t\t// Net payout is a pass-through via earnings until provider confirms\n\t\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: earningsAcct.ID, AmountKobo: amountKobo, Description: \"EWA payout staging\", RefType: \"cashout\"},\n\t\t\t{ID: uuid.New(), JournalID: journalID, AccountID: earningsAcct.ID, AmountKobo: -amountKobo, Description: \"EWA payout to bank\", RefType: \"cashout\"},\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif err := s.ledger.journal(ctx, tx, entries); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := s.ledger.adjustBalance(ctx, tx, driverWallet.ID, -(amountKobo + EWACashoutFeeKobo)); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"EWACashout: adjust driver balance: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tcashout := model.CashoutRequest{\n\t\t\tID:             uuid.New(),\n\t\t\tDriverID:       driverID,\n\t\t\tAmountKobo:     amountKobo,\n\t\t\tFeeKobo:        EWACashoutFeeKobo,\n\t\t\tStatus:         \"pending\",\n\t\t\tIdempotencyKey: idempotencyKey,\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn s.repo.CreateCashoutTx(ctx, tx, &cashout)\n\t})\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tif s.enqueue != nil {\n\t\tif created, err := s.repo.FindCashoutByKey(ctx, idempotencyKey); Cached by the client.\nfunc (h *DriverBankHandler) ListBanks(c *gin.Context) {\n\tbanks, err := h.paystack.ListBanks(c.Request.Context())\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tinternalError(c, err)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\t// Normalise to {code, name} — same shape as the frontend expects.\n\ttype bankRow struct {\n\t\tCode string `json:\"code\"`\n\t\tName string `json:\"name\"`\n\t}\n\trows := make([]bankRow, len(banks))\n\tfor i, b := range banks {\n\t\trows[i] = bankRow{Code: b.Code, Name: b.Name}\n\t}\n\tc.JSON(http.StatusOK, successResp(gin.H{\"banks\": rows}))\n}\n\n// ResolveAccount — POST /drivers/bank-account/resolve\n// Calls Paystack to verify the account number and return the authoritative name.\nfunc (h *DriverBankHandler) ResolveAccount(c *gin.Context) {\n\tvar req struct {\n\t\tBankCode      string `json:\"bankCode\"      binding:\"required\"`\n\t\tAccountNumber string `json:\"accountNumber\" binding:\"required\"`\n\t}\n\tif err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req); err != nil {\n\t\tvalidationError(c, err)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tname, err := h.wallet.ResolveDriverBankAccount(c.Request.Context(), req.BankCode, req.AccountNumber)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tc.JSON(http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, errResp(\"VALIDATION_ERROR\", \"Could not verify account — check the account number and bank code\", \"accountNumber\"))\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.JSON(http.StatusOK, successResp(gin.H{\"accountName\": name}))\n}\n\n// SaveAccount — POST /drivers/bank-account\n// Resolves the account name server-side, then persists the verified account.\nfunc (h *DriverBankHandler) SaveAccount(c *gin.Context) {\n\tvar req struct {\n\t\tBankCode      string `json:\"bankCode\"      binding:\"required\"`\n\t\tBankName      string `json:\"bankName\"      binding:\"required\"`\n\t\tAccountNumber string `json:\"accountNumber\" binding:\"required\"`\n\t}\n\tif err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&req);           "tool_uses": [

              "id": "tooluse_HwdnwTV5j7zO1mrajuWByb",
              "name": "fs_write",
              "orig_name": "fs_write",
              "args": {
                "command": "create",
                "file_text": "-- Composite indexes for the admin metrics queries and order history pages.\n-- orders(created_at) alone covers the \"today\" range scans.\n-- orders(status, created_at) covers the filtered counts (cancelled today, etc.).\n-- payment_intents(status, created_at) covers the failed-payments count.\n-- All use IF NOT EXISTS so re-running is safe.\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_orders_created_at\n    ON orders(created_at DESC);\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_orders_status_created_at\n    ON orders(status, created_at DESC);\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_payment_intents_status_created_at\n    ON payment_intents(status, created_at DESC);\n",
                "path": "/home/obeej/Projects/speedplus/apps/api/internal/migrations/036_metrics_indexes.up.sql"
              },
              "orig_args": {
                "command": "create",
                "file_text": "-- Composite indexes for the admin metrics queries and order history pages.\n-- orders(created_at) alone covers the \"today\" range scans.\n-- orders(status, created_at) covers the filtered counts (cancelled today, etc.).\n-- payment_intents(status, created_at) covers the failed-payments count.\n-- All use IF NOT EXISTS so re-running is safe.\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_orders_created_at\n    ON orders(created_at DESC);\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_orders_status_created_at\n    ON orders(status, created_at DESC);\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_payment_intents_status_created_at\n    ON payment_intents(status, created_at DESC);\n",
                "path": "/home/obeej/Projects/speedplus/apps/api/internal/migrations/036_metrics_indexes.up.sql"
              }
            }
          ]

                    "Text": "package service\n\nimport (\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"github.com/speedplus/api/internal/model\"\n)\n\n// ── State machine: refill states ──────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nfunc TestRefillStatesInValidTransitions(t *testing.T) {\n\trequired := []model.OrderStatus{\n\t\tmodel.OrderAwaitingCollection,\n\t\tmodel.OrderEmptyCollected,\n\t\tmodel.OrderAtPlant,\n\t}\n\tfor _, s := range required {\n\t\tif _, ok := model.ValidTransitions[s]; !ok {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"refill state %q missing from ValidTransitions\", s)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestRefillStateMachineChain(t *testing.T) {\n\t// driver_assigned → awaiting_collection → empty_collected → at_plant → in_transit → delivered\n\tchain := []struct{ from, to model.OrderStatus }{\n\t\t{model.OrderDriverAssigned, model.OrderAwaitingCollection},\n\t\t{model.OrderAwaitingCollection, model.OrderEmptyCollected},\n\t\t{model.OrderEmptyCollected, model.OrderAtPlant},\n\t\t{model.OrderAtPlant, model.OrderInTransit},\n\t\t{model.OrderInTransit, model.OrderDelivered},\n\t}\n\tfor _, step := range chain {\n\t\tallowed := model.ValidTransitions[step.from]\n\t\tfound := false\n\t\tfor _, s := range allowed {\n\t\t\tif s == step.to {\n\t\t\t\tfound = true\n\t\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !found {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"transition %s → %s not in ValidTransitions\", step.from, step.to)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestSwapPathUnchanged(t *testing.T) {\n\t// Swap orders use driver_assigned → in_transit — must still be valid.\n\tallowed := model.ValidTransitions[model.OrderDriverAssigned]\n\tfound := false\n\tfor _, s := range allowed {\n\t\tif s == model.OrderInTransit {\n\t\t\tfound = true\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif !found {\n\t\tt.Error(\"driver_assigned → in_transit must remain valid for swap orders\")\n\t}"
                  }

              }

        "Response": {
          "message_id": "40c46dcd-9578-4b34-a254-cc2d6974d51a",
          "content": "---\n\nHere's exactly what changed and why each decision was made:\n\n**P0 — WhatsApp placeholder removed.** `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPPORT_WHATSAPP` env var added to `.env.local`. Support message now includes a `SUP-YYYYMMDD-NNNNN` reference ID so support staff can track cases without a ticketing system. If the env var is unset, the button does nothing rather than opening a dead link.\n\n**P0 — Account number masked at the source.** The masking happens in `driver_bank.go`'s `maskAccount()` helper, applied in both `SaveAccount` and `GetAccount` responses. The full number never leaves the backend on read paths. The frontend display (`****{slice(-4)}`) is now redundant but harmless — defence in depth.\n\n**P0 — Backend enforces bank account before cashout.** `EWACashout` now calls `FindDriverBankAccountTx` before opening any transaction. Returns `ErrBankAccountRequired` (a typed sentinel) so callers can distinguish it from other errors. The frontend gate is still there but is no longer the only control.\n\n**P1 — Bank dropdown replaces free-text code input.** `GET /banks` proxies Paystack's bank list (public, no auth required). The driver app fetches it lazily when the form opens and caches it for 24 hours. Selecting a bank auto-fills both `bankCode` and `bankName`, eliminating the main source of resolve failures.\n\n**P1 — Rate limit on `/drivers/bank-account/resolve`.** 5 requests/minute/IP, fail-closed (503 on Redis outage). Same pattern as auth/OTP.\n\n**P1 — DB indexes.** Migration 036 adds `idx_orders_created_at`, `idx_orders_status_created_at`, and `idx_payment_intents_status_created_at`. All `IF NOT EXISTS` — safe to re-run.\n\n**PIN timing leak fixed.** Both `auth.go` and `paycode.go` now return `\"PIN temporarily locked. Try again later.\"` — no time value in the message.\n\n**Admin metrics auth** — verified already protected by `RequireRole(\"admin\")` on the `admin` group. No change needed.\n\n**Tests added** — `pin_cashout_test.go` covers: lock triggers after 5th failure, locked PIN rejects without revealing time, success resets counter, cashout without bank account returns typed error. All pass with `-race`.\n\n**Pre-existing pharmacy TypeScript errors** — confirmed present on `dev` before our changes. Not our regression."
        }
      },

                    "Text": "=== Operation 1 Result (Text) ===\nimport { create } from 'zustand';\nimport { persist } from 'zustand/middleware';\nimport type { QuoteResult } from '@/lib/store/package-flow.store';\n\nexport type PharmacyTab = 'otc' | 'rx';\n// Mirrors the backend's real prescription.status values (service/catalog.go)\n// plus the client-only 'uploading' transient state for the upload-in-flight UI.\nexport type RxStatus = 'uploading' | 'pending' | 'approved' | 'rejected' | 'expired';\n\nexport interface OtcItem {\n  id: string;\n  name: string;\n  description: string;\n  price: number;\n}\n\nexport const OTC_ITEMS: OtcItem[] = [\n  { id: 'paracetamol', name: 'Paracetamol (20 tabs)', description: 'Pain & fever relief', price: 800 },\n  { id: 'ors', name: 'ORS + Zinc', description: 'Rehydration sachets', price: 1200 },\n  { id: 'vitc', name: 'Vitamin C (30 tabs)', description: 'Immune support', price: 1500 },\n  { id: 'malariakit', name: 'Malaria test kit', description: 'Rapid diagnostic kit', price: 2000 },\n];\n\nexport interface PharmacyAddress {\n  id: string;\n  label?: string;\n  street: string;\n  city: string;\n  lat: number;\n  lng: number;\n}\n\ninterface PharmacyFlowState {\n  tab: PharmacyTab;\n  otcItemId: string | null;\n  rxStatus: RxStatus | null;\n  // The pharmacy the Rx was submitted to — required by the backend as of the\n  // integrity fix (a prescription with no target pharmacy could never be\n  // reviewed). Must be chosen before upload. Lat/lng are the quote origin.\n  merchantId: string | null;\n  merchantLat: number | null;\n  merchantLng: number | null;\n  deliverToId: string | null;\n  deliverToAddress: PharmacyAddress | null;\n  quote: QuoteResult | null;\n  orderId: string | null;\n  prescriptionId: string | null;\n  setTab: (v: PharmacyTab) => void;\n  setOtcItemId: (v: string) => void;\n  setMerchant: (id: string, lat: number, lng: number) => void;\n  setRxStatus: (v: RxStatus | null) => void;\n  setPrescriptionId: (v: string | null) => void;\n  setDeliverTo: (v: PharmacyAddress) => void;\n  setQuote: (v: QuoteResult) => void;\n  setOrderId: (v: string | null) => void;\n  reset: () => void;\n  canContinueItems: () => boolean;\n}\n\nexport const usePharmacyFlowStore = create<PharmacyFlowState>()(\n  persist(\n    (set, get) => ({\n      tab: 'otc',\n      otcItemId: null,\n      rxStatus: null,\n      merchantId: null,\n      merchantLat: null,\n      merchantLng: null,\n      deliverToId: null,\n      deliverToAddress: null,\n      quote: null,\n      orderId: null,\n      prescriptionId: null,\n      setTab: (v) => set({ tab: v }),\n      setOtcItemId: (v) => set({ otcItemId: v, quote: null }),\n      setMerchant: (id, lat, lng) => set({ merchantId: id, merchantLat: lat, merchantLng: lng, quote: null }),\n      setRxStatus: (v) => set({ rxStatus: v }),\n      setPrescriptionId: (v) => set({ prescriptionId: v }),\n      setDeliverTo: (v) => set({ deliverToId: v.id, deliverToAddress: v, quote: null }),\n      setQuote: (v) => set({ quote: v }),\n      setOrderId: (v) => set({ orderId: v }),\n      reset: () =>\n        set({\n          tab: 'otc',\n          otcItemId: null,\n          rxStatus: null,\n          merchantId: null,\n          merchantLat: null,\n          merchantLng: null,\n          deliverToId: null,\n          deliverToAddress: null,\n          quote: null,\n          orderId: null,\n          prescriptionId: null,\n        }),\n      canContinueItems: () => {\n        const { tab, otcItemId, rxStatus } = get();\n        return tab === 'otc' ? Boolean(otcItemId) : rxStatus === 'approved';\n      },\n    }),\n    { name: 'speedplus-pharmacy-flow' },\n  ),\n);\n\n=== Operation 2 Result (Text) ===\n'use client';\n\nimport { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';\nimport { Button } from '@speedplus/ui';\nimport { FlowHeader } from '../../components/flow-header';\nimport { usePharmacyFlowStore, OTC_ITEMS } from '../../../lib/store/pharmacy-flow.store';\nimport { useCreateOrder } from '../../../lib/hooks/use-order-mutations';\n\nfunction naira(n: number) {\n  return `₦${n.toLocaleString('en-NG')}`;\n}\n\nexport default function PharmacyPricePage() {\n  const router = useRouter();\n  const { priceBreakdown, km, tab, otcItemId, deliverTo, prescriptionId, setOrderId } = usePharmacyFlowStore();\n  const { base, distance, item, total } = priceBreakdown();\n  const itemLabel = tab === 'otc' ? (OTC_ITEMS.find((o) => o.id === otcItemId)?.name ?? 'Item') : 'Prescription items';\n  const createOrder = useCreateOrder();\n\n  function handleConfirm() {\n    if (!deliverTo) return;\n    if (tab === 'otc' && !otcItemId) return;\n    if (tab === 'rx' && !prescriptionId) return;\n\n    createOrder.mutate(\n      {\n        merchantId: 'healthplus-lekki',\n        vertical: 'pharmacy',\n        items: tab === 'otc' ? [{ productId: otcItemId!, quantity: 1 }] : [],\n        deliveryAddressId: deliverTo,\n        prescriptionId: tab === 'rx' ? (prescriptionId ?? undefined) : undefined,\n      },\n      {\n        onSuccess: (order) => {\n          setOrderId(order.id);\n          router.push('/pharmacy/finding');\n        },\n        // No onSettled navigate — only navigate on success.\n      },\n    );\n  }\n\n  const canConfirm =\n    Boolean(deliverTo) &&\n    (tab === 'otc' ? Boolean(otcItemId) : Boolean(prescriptionId)) &&\n    !createOrder.isPending;\n\n  return (\n    <main className=\"min-h-screen bg-sand flex flex-col\">\n      <FlowHeader title=\"Here's the price\" step={3} backHref=\"/pharmacy/deliver\" />\n\n      <div className=\"flex-1 px-5 py-5 flex flex-col gap-6 min-[700px]:max-w-[860px] min-[700px]:mx-auto min-[700px]:px-8 min-[700px]:py-10 min-[700px]:w-full\">\n        <div className=\"bg-white border border-line rounded-2xl p-5 flex flex-col gap-3\">\n          <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between text-[14px]\">\n            <span className=\"text-mid\">Delivery ({km().toFixed(1)} km)</span>\n            <span className=\"text-ink font-medium\">{naira(distance)}</span>\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between text-[14px]\">\n            <span className=\"text-mid\">{itemLabel}</span>\n            <span className=\"text-ink font-medium\">{naira(item)}</span>\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between text-[14px]\">\n            <span className=\"text-mid\">Base fare</span>\n            <span className=\"text-ink font-medium\">{naira(base)}</span>\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"h-px bg-line my-1\" />\n          <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n            <span className=\"font-display font-semibold text-lg text-ink\">Total</span>\n            <span className=\"font-display font-bold text-2xl text-emerald\">{naira(total)}</span>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        <span className=\"text-[13px] text-mid\">\n          You pay {naira(total)} when it arrives — cash or card, your choice.\n        </span>\n\n        {createOrder.isError && (\n          <span className=\"text-xs text-red-600\" role=\"alert\">\n            {(createOrder.error as Error).message}\n          </span>\n        )}\n\n        <Button\n          variant=\"primary\"\n          size=\"lg\"\n          disabled={!canConfirm}\n          isLoading={createOrder.isPending}\n          onClick={handleConfirm}\n          className=\"w-full min-[700px]:max-w-[380px]\"\n        >\n          Confirm order\n        </Button>\n      </div>\n    </main>\n  );\n}\n\n=== Operation 3 Result (Text) ===\n'use client';\n\nimport { useEffect, useState } from 'react';\nimport { usePharmacyFlowStore } from '../../../lib/store/pharmacy-flow.store';\nimport { useTrackOrder } from '../../../lib/hooks/use-order-mutations';\n\nconst STEPS = ['Order confirmed', 'Pharmacist packed and sealed it', 'On the way', 'Delivered'];\n\nconst STATUS_STEP: Record<string, number> = {\n  pending: 0,\n  confirmed: 0,\n  preparing: 1,\n  ready_for_pickup: 1,\n  driver_assigned: 1,\n  in_transit: 2,\n  delivered: 3,\n};\n\nexport default function PharmacyTrackingPage() {\n  const { deliverTo, orderId, reset } = usePharmacyFlowStore();\n  const { data: liveOrder } =                 "content": [
                  {
                    "Text": "'use client';\n\nimport { useEffect, useState } from 'react';\nimport { useParams, useRouter } from 'next/navigation';\nimport { paymentLinksApi, walletApi } from '@speedplus/api-client';\nimport { Button, SpeedPlusLogo } from '@speedplus/ui';\n\nfunction naira(kobo: number) {\n  return `₦${(kobo / 100).toLocaleString('en-NG', { minimumFractionDigits: 2 })}`;\n}\n\nexport default function PayLinkPage() {\n  const { slug } = useParams<{ slug: string }>();\n  const router = useRouter();\n\n  const [link, setLink] = useState<{ amountKobo: number; note?: string; expiresAt: string } | null>(null);\n  const [balance, setBalance] = useState<number | null>(null);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [paying, setPaying] = useState(false);\n  const [paid, setPaid] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState('');\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    Promise.all([\n      paymentLinksApi.getBySlug(slug),\n      walletApi.getBalance().catch(() => null),\n    ]).then(([l, w]) => {\n      setLink(l);\n      if (w) setBalance(w.balanceKobo);\n    }).catch((e: Error) => setError(e.message))\n      .finally(() => setLoading(false));\n  }, [slug]);\n\n  async function handlePay() {\n    setPaying(true);\n    setError('');\n    try {\n      const key = `pay-${slug}-${Date.now()}`;\n      await paymentLinksApi.pay(slug, key);\n      setPaid(true);\n    } catch (e: unknown) {\n      setError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Payment failed');\n    } finally {\n      setPaying(false);\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (loading) {\n    return (\n      <div className=\"min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center\" style={{ background: '#F7F5EF' }}>\n        <div className=\"w-10 h-10 rounded-full border-2 border-[#C6F24E] border-t-transparent animate-spin\" />\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n\n  if (paid) {\n    return (\n      <div className=\"min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-6 px-6\" style={{ background: '#F7F5EF' }}>\n        <div className=\"w-16 h-16 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center\" style={{ background: '#C6F24E' }}>\n          <svg width=\"28\" height=\"28\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"#0A3D2C\" strokeWidth={2.5} strokeLinecap=\"round\" strokeLinejoin=\"round\">\n            <path d=\"M5 13l4 4L19 7\" />\n          </svg>\n        </div>\n        <div className=\"text-center\">\n          <p className=\"font-display font-bold text-[22px] text-ink\">Payment sent</p>\n          <p className=\"text-[13px] text-mid mt-1\">{link ? naira(link.amountKobo) : ''} paid successfully</p>\n        </div>\n        <Button variant=\"secondary\" onClick={() => router.push('/')}>Back to home</Button>\n      </div>\n    );\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <div className=\"min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-5 py-10\" style={{ background: '#F7F5EF' }}>\n      <div className=\"w-full max-w-sm flex flex-col gap-5\">\n        {/* Logo */}\n        <div className=\"flex justify-center mb-2\">\n          <SpeedPlusLogo size={32} />\n        </div>\n\n        {error && (\n          <div className=\"bg-[#FEF2F2] border border-[#FECACA] rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm text-[#DC2626]\">{error}</div>\n        )}\n\n        {link ? (\n          <div className=\"bg-white border border-line rounded-2xl p-6 flex flex-col gap-5\">\n            {/* Amount */}\n            <div className=\"text-center\">\n              <p className=\"font-display font-bold text-[36px] text-ink leading-none\">{naira(link.amountKobo)}</p>\n              {link.note && <p className=\"text-[13px] text-mid mt-2\">{link.note}</p>}\n            </div>\n\n            <div className=\"h-px bg-line\" />\n\n            {/* Wallet balance */}\n            {balance !== null && (\n              <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between text-[13px]\">\n                <span className=\"text-mid\">Wallet balance</span>\n                <span className={`font-semibold ${balance >= link.amountKobo ? 'text-[#0A3D2C]' : 'text-[#DC2626]'}`}>\n                  {naira(balance)}\n                </span>\n              </div>\n            )}\n\n            {/* Expiry */}\n            <p className=\"text-[11.5px] text-mid text-center\">\n              Expires {new Date(link.expiresAt).toLocaleDateString('en-NG', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' })}\n            </p>\n\n            <Button\n              onClick={handlePay}\n              isLoading={paying}\n              disabled={paying || (balance !== null && balance < link.amountKobo)}\n            >\n              {balance !== null && balance < link.amountKobo ? 'Insufficient balance' : `Pay ${naira(link.amountKobo)}`}\n            </Button>\n\n            {balance !== null && balance < link.amountKobo && (\n              <Button variant=\"outline\" onClick={() => router.push('/wallet/fund')}>\n                Top up wallet\n              </Button>\n            )}\n          </div>\n        ) : (\n          <div className=\"bg-white border border-line rounded-2xl p-6 text-center\">\n            <p className=\"text-[14px] text-mid\">This payment link is invalid or has expired.</p>\n          </div>\n        )}\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  );\n}"
                  }

                    "Text": "=== Operation 1 Result (Text) ===\nimport { create } from 'zustand';\nimport { persist } from 'zustand/middleware';\nimport type { QuoteResult } from '@/lib/store/package-flow.store';\n\nexport interface FoodAddress {\n  id: string;\n  label?: string;\n  street: string;\n  city: string;\n  lat: number;\n  lng: number;\n}\n\ninterface FoodFlowState {\n  // Merchant (kitchen) chosen from the list\n  merchantId: string | null;\n  merchantLat: number | null;\n  merchantLng: number | null;\n  // Single product selected from the merchant's menu\n  productId: string | null;\n  productPriceKobo: number | null;\n  // Delivery destination\n  deliverToId: string | null;\n  deliverToAddress: FoodAddress | null;\n  // Quote from server — set before navigating to price page\n  quote: QuoteResult | null;\n  orderId: string | null;\n  setMerchant: (id: string, lat: number, lng: number) => void;\n  setProduct: (id: string, priceKobo: number) => void;\n  setDeliverTo: (v: FoodAddress) => void;\n  setQuote: (v: QuoteResult) => void;\n  setOrderId: (v: string | null) => void;\n  reset: () => void;\n}\n\nexport const useFoodFlowStore = create<FoodFlowState>()(\n  persist(\n    (set) => ({\n      merchantId: null,\n      merchantLat: null,\n      merchantLng: null,\n      productId: null,\n      productPriceKobo: null,\n      deliverToId: null,\n      deliverToAddress: null,\n      quote: null,\n      orderId: null,\n      setMerchant: (id, lat, lng) => set({ merchantId: id, merchantLat: lat, merchantLng: lng, productId: null, productPriceKobo: null, quote: null }),\n      setProduct: (id, priceKobo) => set({ productId: id, productPriceKobo: priceKobo, quote: null }),\n      setDeliverTo: (v) => set({ deliverToId: v.id, deliverToAddress: v, quote: null }),\n      setQuote: (v) => set({ quote: v }),\n      setOrderId: (v) => set({ orderId: v }),\n      reset: () => set({ merchantId: null, merchantLat: null, merchantLng: null, productId: null, productPriceKobo: null, deliverToId: null, deliverToAddress: null, quote: null, orderId: null }),\n    }),\n    { name: 'speedplus-food-flow' },\n  ),\n);\n\n=== Operation 2 Result (Text) ===\n'use client';\n\nimport { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';\nimport { Button } from '@speedplus/ui';\nimport { FlowHeader } from '../../components/flow-header';\nimport { useFoodFlowStore } from '../../../lib/store/food-flow.store';\nimport { useCreateOrder } from '../../../lib/hooks/use-order-mutations';\n\nfunction naira(n: number) {\n  return `₦${n.toLocaleString('en-NG')}`;\n}\n\nexport default function FoodPricePage() {\n  const router = useRouter();\n  const { priceBreakdown, km, meal, deliverTo, setOrderId } = useFoodFlowStore();\n  const { base, distance, item, total } = priceBreakdown();\n  const m = meal();\n  const createOrder = useCreateOrder();\n\n  function handleConfirm() {\n    if (!m || !deliverTo) return;\n    createOrder.mutate(\n      {\n        merchantId: m.kitchen,\n        vertical: 'food',\n        items: [{ productId: m.id, quantity: 1 }],\n        deliveryAddressId: deliverTo,\n      },\n      {\n        onSuccess: (order) => {\n          setOrderId(order.id);\n          router.push('/food/finding');\n        },\n        // No onSettled navigate — only navigate on success.\n      },\n    );\n  }\n\n  const canConfirm = Boolean(m && deliverTo) && !createOrder.isPending;\n\n  return (\n    <main className=\"min-h-screen bg-sand flex flex-col\">\n      <FlowHeader title=\"Here's the price\" step={3} backHref=\"/food/deliver\" />\n\n      <div className=\"flex-1 px-5 py-5 flex flex-col gap-6 min-[700px]:max-w-[860px] min-[700px]:mx-auto min-[700px]:px-8 min-[700px]:py-10 min-[700px]:w-full\">\n        <div className=\"bg-white border border-line rounded-2xl p-5 flex flex-col gap-3\">\n          <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between text-[14px]\">\n            <span className=\"text-mid\">Delivery ({km().toFixed(1)} km)</span>\n            <span className=\"text-ink font-medium\">{naira(distance)}</span>\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between text-[14px]\">\n            <span className=\"text-mid\">{m?.name ?? 'Meal'}</span>\n            <span className=\"text-ink font-medium\">{naira(item)}</span>\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between text-[14px]\">\n            <span className=\"text-mid\">Base fare</span>\n            <span className=\"text-ink font-medium\">{naira(base)}</span>\n          </div>\n          <div className=\"h-px bg-line my-1\" />\n          <div className=\"flex items-center justify-between\">\n            <span className=\"font-display font-semibold text-lg text-ink\">Total</span>\n            <span className=\"font-display font-bold text-2xl text-emerald\">{naira(total)}</span>\n          </div>\n        </div>\n\n        <span className=\"text-[13px] text-mid\">\n          You pay {naira(total)} when it arrives — cash or card, your choice.\n        </span>\n\n        {createOrder.isError && (\n          <span className=\"text-xs text-red-600\" role=\"alert\">\n            {(createOrder.error as Error).message}\n          </span>\n        )}\n\n        <Button\n          variant=\"primary\"\n          size=\"lg\"\n          disabled={!canConfirm}\n          isLoading={createOrder.isPending}\n          onClick={handleConfirm}\n          className=\"w-full min-[700px]:max-w-[380px]\"\n        >\n          Confirm order\n        </Button>\n      </div>\n    </main>\n  );\n}\n\n=== Operation 3 Result (Text) ===\n'use client';\n\nimport { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';\nimport { Button } from '@speedplus/ui';\nimport { FlowHeader } from '../../components/flow-header';\nimport { SelectTile } from '../../components/select-tile';\nimport { useFoodFlowStore } from '../../../lib/store/food-flow.store';\n\nconst DELIVER_SHORTCUTS = [\n  { label: '🏠 My home', value: 'Home — 14 Admiralty Way, Lekki Phase 1' },\n  { label: '📍 Where I am now', value: 'Current location' },\n  { label: 'Office', value: 'Office — 22 Adeola Odeku, Victoria Island' },\n];\n\nexport default function FoodDeliverPage() {\n  const router = useRouter();\n  const { deliverTo, setDeliverTo } = useFoodFlowStore();\n  const canContinue = Boolean(deliverTo);\n\n  return (\n    <main className=\"min-h-screen bg-sand flex flex-col\">\n      <FlowHeader title=\"Where should we bring it?\" step={2} backHref=\"/food/menu\" />\n\n      <div className=\"flex-1 px-5 py-5 flex flex-col gap-6 min-[700px]:max-w-[860px] min-[700px]:mx-auto min-[700px]:px-8 min-[700px]:py-10 min-[700px]:w-full\">\n        <section className=\"flex flex-col gap-2.5\">\n          <span className=\"text-[13px] font-semibold text-mid\">Delivery address</span>\n          <div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\">\n            {DELIVER_SHORTCUTS.map((s) => (\n              <SelectTile key={s.value} label={s.label} selected={deliverTo === s.value} onClick={() => setDeliverTo(s.value)} />\n            ))}\n          </div>\n        </section>\n\n        {canContinue && (\n          <span className=\"text-[13px] text-mid\">\n            ✓ Delivering to <b className=\"text-emerald\">{deliverTo}</b>. Next: see the price.\n          </span>\n        )}\n\n        <span className=\"text-xs text-mid\">Nothing is paid yet.</span>\n\n        <Button\n          variant=\"primary\"\n          size=\"lg\"\n          disabled={!canContinue}\n          onClick={() => router.push('/food/price')}\n          className=\"w-full min-[700px]:max-w-[380px]\"\n        >\n          Continue\n        </Button>\n      </div>\n    </main>\n  );\n}\n\n=== Operation 4 Result (Text) ===\n'use client';\n\nimport { useEffect, useState } from 'react';\nimport { useFoodFlowStore } from '../../../lib/store/food-flow.store';\nimport { useTrackOrder } from '../../../lib/hooks/use-order-mutations';\n\nconst STEPS = ['Order confirmed', 'Kitchen cooked it fresh', 'On the way', 'Delivered'];\n\nconst STATUS_STEP: Record<string, number> = {\n  pending: 0,\n  confirmed: 0,\n  preparing: 1,\n  ready_for_pickup: 1,\n  driver_assigned: 1,\n  in_transit: 2,\n  delivered: 3,\n};\n\nexport default function FoodTrackingPage() {\n  const { deliverTo, orderId, reset } = useFoodFlowStore();\n  const { data: liveOrder } = useTrackOrder(orderId);\n  const [stepIndex, setStepIndex] = useState(1);\n  const [etaMin, setEtaMin] = useState(4);\n\n  const effectiveStepIndex = liveOrder ? (STATUS_STEP[liveOrder.status] ?? stepIndex) : stepIndex;\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (liveOrder) return;\n    const stepTimer = setInterval(() => setStepIndex((s) => Math.min(s + 1, STEPS.length - 1)), 8000);\n    const etaTimer = setInterval(() => setEtaMin((m) => Math.max(m - 1, 0)), 15000);\n    return () => {\n      clearInterval(stepTimer);\n      clearInterval(etaTimer);\n    };\n  }, [liveOrder]);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (effectiveStepIndex === STEPS.length - 1) reset();\n  }, [effectiveStepIndex, reset]);\n\n  return (\n    <main className=\"min-h-screen bg-sand flex flex-col\">\n      <div className=\"bg-emerald relative overflow-hidden px-5 py-8 min-[700px]:px-9 min-[700px]:py-12 flex flex-col items-center gap-3\">\n        <svg width=\"90\" height=\"90\" viewBox=\"0 0 90 90\" className=\"mb-1\">\n          <circle cx=\"45\" cy=\"45\" r=\"6\" fill=\"#C6F24E\" />\n          <circle cx=\"45\" cy=\"45\" r=\"6\" fill=\"#C6F24E\" opacity=\"0.4\">\n            <animate attributeName=\"r\" values=\"6;20;6\" dur=\"2s\" repeatCount=\"indefinite\" />\n            <animate attributeName=\"opacity\" values=\"0.4;0;0.4\" dur=\"2s\" repeatCount=\"indefinite\" />\n          </circle>\n          <path d=\"M20 60 Q45 20 70 60\" stroke=\"#C6F24E\" strokeWidth=\"2\" strokeDasharray=\"4 5\" fill=\"none\" />\n        </svg>\n        <span className=\"font-display font-bold text-3xl text-lime\">{etaMin} min</span>\n        <span className=\"text-sm text-sand/70\">{deliverTo ? `Arriving at ${deliverTo}` : 'On its way'}</span>\n      </div>\n\n      <div className=\"flex-1 px-5 py-6 min-[700px]:max-w-[860px] min-[700px]:mx-auto min-[700px]:px-8 min-[700px]:py-10 min-[700px]:w-full flex flex-col gap-6\">\n        <div className=\"bg-white border border-line rounded-2xl p-4 flex items-center gap-3\">\n          <span className=\"w-11 h-11 rounded-full bg-tile flex items-center justify-center font-display font-semibold text-emerald\">T</span>\n          <div className=\"flex-1 flex flex-col\">\n            <span className=\"font-semibold text-ink text-[14px]\">Tunde</span>\n            <span className=\"text-[12px] text-mid\">Bike · ★ 4.7</span>\n          </div>\n          <button className=\"w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-tile flex items-center justify-center\" aria-label=\"Call rider\">\n            <svg width=\"16\" height=\"16\" viewBox=\"0 0 24 24\" fill=\"none\" stroke=\"#0A3D2C\" strokeWidth={1.8} strokeLinecap=\"round\" strokeLinejoin=\"round\">\n              <path d=\"M22 16.92v3a2 2 0 01-2.18 2 19.79 19.79 0 01-8.63-3.07 19.5 19.5 0 01-6-6 19.79 19.79 0 01-3.07-8.67A2 2 0 014.11 2h3a2 2 0 012 1.72c.127.96.361 1.903.7 2.81a2 2 0 01-.45 2.11L8.09 9.91a16 16 0 006 6l1.27-1.27a2 2 0 012.11-.45c.907.339 1.85.573 2.81.7A2 2 0 0122 16.92z\" />\n            </svg>\n          </button>\n        </div>\n\n        {deliverTo && (\n          <span className=\"text-[13px] text-mid\">\n            Delivering to <b className=\"text-ink\">{deliverTo}</b>\n          </span>\n        )}\n\n        <div className=\"flex flex-col gap-0\">\n          {STEPS.map((label, i) => {\n            const done = i <= effectiveStepIndex;\n            return (\n              <div key={label} className=\"flex gap-3\">\n                <div className=\"flex flex-col items-center\">\n                  <span className={`w-3 h-3 rounded-full ${done ? 'bg-emerald' : 'bg-line'}`} />\n                  {i < STEPS.length - 1 && <span className={`w-0.5 flex-1 min-h-[28px] ${done ? 'bg-emerald' : 'bg-line'}`} />}\n                </div>\n                <span className={`text-[14px] pb-7 ${done ? 'text-ink font-medium' : 'text-mid'}`}>{label}</span>\n              </div>\n            );\n          })}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    </main>\n  );\n}"

                "file_text": "'use client';\n\nimport { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';\nimport { Button } from '@speedplus/ui';\nimport { FlowHeader } from '../../components/flow-header';\nimport { SelectTile } from '../../components/select-tile';\nimport { useFoodFlowStore, type FoodAddress } from '../../../lib/store/food-flow.store';\n\n// Placeholder shortcuts — in production these come from the user's saved addresses.\nconst DELIVER_SHORTCUTS: { label: string; address: FoodAddress }[] = [\n  {\n    label: '🏠 My home',\n    address: { id: 'home', label: 'Home', street: '14 Admiralty Way', city: 'Lekki Phase 1', lat: 6.4281, lng: 3.4219 },\n  },\n  {\n    label: '📍 Where I am now',\n    address: { id: 'current', label: 'Current location', street: 'Current location', city: 'Lagos', lat: 6.4550, lng: 3.3841 },\n  },\n  {\n    label: 'Office',\n    address: { id: 'office', label: 'Office', street: '22 Adeola Odeku', city: 'Victoria Island', lat: 6.4281, lng: 3.4219 },\n  },\n];\n\nexport default function FoodDeliverPage() {\n  const router = useRouter();\n  const { deliverToId, setDeliverTo } = useFoodFlowStore();\n  const canContinue = Boolean(deliverToId);\n  const selected = DELIVER_SHORTCUTS.find((s) => s.address.id === deliverToId);\n\n  return (\n    <main className=\"min-h-screen bg-sand flex flex-col\">\n      <FlowHeader title=\"Where should we bring it?\" step={2} backHref=\"/food/menu\" />\n\n      <div className=\"flex-1 px-5 py-5 flex flex-col gap-6 min-[700px]:max-w-[860px] min-[700px]:mx-auto min-[700px]:px-8 min-[700px]:py-10 min-[700px]:w-full\">\n        <section className=\"flex flex-col gap-2.5\">\n          <span className=\"text-[13px] font-semibold text-mid\">Delivery address</span>\n          <div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\">\n            {DELIVER_SHORTCUTS.map((s) => (\n              <SelectTile\n                key={s.address.id}\n                label={s.label}\n                selected={deliverToId === s.address.id}\n                onClick={() => setDeliverTo(s.address)}\n              />\n            ))}\n          </div>\n        </section>\n\n        {selected && (\n          <span className=\"text-[13px] text-mid\">\n            ✓ Delivering to <b className=\"text-emerald\">{selected.address.street}, {selected.address.city}</b>. Next: see the price.\n          </span>\n        )}\n\n        <span className=\"text-xs text-mid\">Nothing is paid yet.</span>\n\n        <Button\n          variant=\"primary\"\n          size=\"lg\"\n          disabled={!canContinue}\n          onClick={() => router.push('/food/price')}\n          className=\"w-full min-[700px]:max-w-[380px]\"\n        >\n          Continue\n        </Button>\n      </div>\n    </main>\n  );\n}\n",

                "command": "create",
                "file_text": "'use client';\n\nimport { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';\nimport { Button } from '@speedplus/ui';\nimport { FlowHeader } from '../../components/flow-header';\nimport { SelectTile } from '../../components/select-tile';\nimport { useFoodFlowStore, type FoodAddress } from '../../../lib/store/food-flow.store';\n\n// Placeholder shortcuts — in production these come from the user's saved addresses.\nconst DELIVER_SHORTCUTS: { label: string; address: FoodAddress }[] = [\n  {\n    label: '🏠 My home',\n    address: { id: 'home', label: 'Home', street: '14 Admiralty Way', city: 'Lekki Phase 1', lat: 6.4281, lng: 3.4219 },\n  },\n  {\n    label: '📍 Where I am now',\n    address: { id: 'current', label: 'Current location', street: 'Current location', city: 'Lagos', lat: 6.4550, lng: 3.3841 },\n  },\n  {\n    label: 'Office',\n    address: { id: 'office', label: 'Office', street: '22 Adeola Odeku', city: 'Victoria Island', lat: 6.4281, lng: 3.4219 },\n  },\n];\n\nexport default function FoodDeliverPage() {\n  const router = useRouter();\n  const { deliverToId, setDeliverTo } = useFoodFlowStore();\n  const canContinue = Boolean(deliverToId);\n  const selected = DELIVER_SHORTCUTS.find((s) => s.address.id === deliverToId);\n\n  return (\n    <main className=\"min-h-screen bg-sand flex flex-col\">\n      <FlowHeader title=\"Where should we bring it?\" step={2} backHref=\"/food/menu\" />\n\n      <div className=\"flex-1 px-5 py-5 flex flex-col gap-6 min-[700px]:max-w-[860px] min-[700px]:mx-auto min-[700px]:px-8 min-[700px]:py-10 min-[700px]:w-full\">\n        <section className=\"flex flex-col gap-2.5\">\n          <span className=\"text-[13px] font-semibold text-mid\">Delivery address</span>\n          <div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\">\n            {DELIVER_SHORTCUTS.map((s) => (\n              <SelectTile\n                key={s.address.id}\n                label={s.label}\n                selected={deliverToId === s.address.id}\n                onClick={() => setDeliverTo(s.address)}\n              />\n            ))}\n          </div>\n        </section>\n\n        {selected && (\n          <span className=\"text-[13px] text-mid\">\n            ✓ Delivering to <b className=\"text-emerald\">{selected.address.street}, {selected.address.city}</b>. Next: see the price.\n          </span>\n        )}\n\n        <span className=\"text-xs text-mid\">Nothing is paid yet.</span>\n\n        <Button\n          variant=\"primary\"\n          size=\"lg\"\n          disabled={!canContinue}\n          onClick={() => router.push('/food/price')}\n          className=\"w-full min-[700px]:max-w-[380px]\"\n        >\n          Continue\n        </Button>\n      </div>\n    </main>\n  );\n}\n",
                "path": "/home/obeej/Projects/speedplus/apps/customer/app/food/deliver/page.tsx"
              }
            }
          ]
        }
      },

      "assistant": {
        "Response": {
          "message_id": "74f883ae-191a-47d9-baba-c36909307702",
          "content": "All clean. Here's what was done and why each decision was made:\n\n**Root cause.** The `PharmacyFlowState` and `FoodFlowState` stores were refactored from a computed-method shape (`priceBreakdown()`, `km()`, `meal()`, `deliverTo: string`) to a server-quote shape (`quote: QuoteResult`, `deliverToId`, `deliverToAddress`). The stores were updated but the pages that consume them were not. The TypeScript errors were the compiler catching that drift.\n\n**Pharmacy price page** — replaced `priceBreakdown()` / `km()` calls with direct reads from `quote.deliveryKobo`, `quote.distanceKm`, `quote.subtotalKobo`, `quote.totalKobo`. Added a null guard that redirects to `/pharmacy/deliver` if `quote` is missing, which is the correct behaviour when a user lands on the price page without completing the flow.\n\n**Pharmacy tracking page** — replaced `deliverTo` (string) with `deliverToAddress` (object), deriving the display label as `street + city`.\n\n**Food price page** — same pattern as pharmacy. Uses `quote` from the store, reads `merchantId` / `productId` / `deliverToId` directly.\n\n**Food deliver page** — the store's `setDeliverTo` now expects a `FoodAddress` object, not a string. Updated the shortcut list to carry full `FoodAddress` objects and pass them through. The display label is derived from `street + city` rather than a raw string.\n\n**Food tracking page** — same as pharmacy tracking: `deliverToAddress` replaces `deliverTo`.\n\n**`pay/[slug]` page** — `paymentLinksApi.getBySlug` doesn't exist; the method is `resolve`. Fixed. `SpeedPlusLogo size={32}` (number) replaced with `size=\"md\"` (the correct string literal that maps to the same 32px mark size)."
        }

          "content": "`next lint` is configured but no `.eslintrc` file exists in any app — it prompts interactively for first-time setup, which fails in CI. This is a pre-existing infrastructure gap, not introduced by our changes. Here's the full picture:\n\n---\n\n## Results\n\n### `go vet` — PASS\nZero issues across all packages.\n\n### `go test -race` — PASS\n**4 packages with tests, all green:**\n\n| Package | Result | Tests run |\n|---|---|---|\n| `internal/crypto` | ✅ PASS | 7 |\n| `internal/middleware` | ✅ PASS | 12 |\n| `internal/payment` | ✅ PASS | 24 |\n| `internal/service` | ✅ PASS | 60+ (37 skipped — need `DATABASE_URL`) |\n\nNew tests added in this sprint all passed:\n- `TestPINLocksAfterFiveFailures` ✅\n- `TestPINLockedRejectsWithoutRevealingTime` ✅\n- `TestSuccessfulPINResetsCounter` ✅\n- `TestCashoutWithoutBankAccountReturnsError` ✅\n\n### TypeScript typecheck — PASS (all 4 apps)\n| App | Result |\n|---|---|\n| customer | ✅ PASS |\n| driver | ✅ PASS |\n| admin | ✅ PASS |\n| merchant | ✅ PASS |\n\n### ESLint — NOT CONFIGURED (pre-existing)\n`next lint` prompts interactively because no `.eslintrc` file exists in any app. This is a pre-existing gap — the lint script is declared in `package.json` but the config file was never created. It fails identically on the base `dev` branch before any of our changes. **Not a regression.**\n\nTo unblock CI lint, each app needs a minimal `.eslintrc.json`:\n\n```json\n{ \"extends\": \"next/core-web-vitals\" }\n```\n\nThat's a one-liner per app and a separate task from this sprint.\n\n### Jest — NOT INSTALLED\nNo `jest.config.*`, no `vitest.config.*`, no test runner in any `package.json` scripts. The frontend has no unit test infrastructure. Also a pre-existing gap, separate from this sprint's scope."

          "message_id": "904e8cc0-8627-4819-85bc-f05c67a3984a",
          "content": "`pnpm exec eslint` works. The issue is the shebang in the `.bin` wrapper when called as a script. Update the lint scripts to use `pnpm exec eslint` pattern — but since scripts run via pnpm, the simplest fix is to call `eslint` directly (pnpm adds workspace `.bin` to PATH when running scripts):",
          "tool_uses": [
            {
              "id": "tooluse_HPVtnGB2bXmvXknWkUYtW6",
              "name": "execute_bash",
              "orig_name": "execute_bash",
              "args": {
                "command": "# Check if pnpm adds workspace root .bin to PATH during script execution\nfor app in customer driver admin merchant; do\n  pkg=\"/home/obeej/Projects/speedplus/apps/$app/package.json\"\n  python3 -c \"\nimport json\nwith open('$pkg') as f: d = json.load(f)\nd['scripts']['lint'] = 'eslint . --max-warnings=0'\nwith open('$pkg', 'w') as f: json.dump(d, f, indent=2)\n\"\ndone\n# Test with pnpm run (not exec) - pnpm adds .bin to PATH for scripts\ncd /home/obeej/Projects/speedplus && pnpm --filter customer run lint 2>&1 | head -5"
              },
              "orig_args": {
                "command": "# Check if pnpm adds workspace root .bin to PATH during script execution\nfor app in customer driver admin merchant; do\n  pkg=\"/home/obeej/Projects/speedplus/apps/$app/package.json\"\n  python3 -c \"\nimport json\nwith open('$pkg') as f: d = json.load(f)\nd['scripts']['lint'] = 'eslint . --max-warnings=0'\nwith open('$pkg', 'w') as f: json.dump(d, f, indent=2)\n\"\ndone\n# Test with pnpm run (not exec) - pnpm adds .bin to PATH for scripts\ncd /home/obeej/Projects/speedplus && pnpm --filter customer run lint 2>&1 | head -5"
              }
            }
          ]
        }
      },

          "content": "All five admin pages have the same pattern: `setError('')` at the top of a `useEffect`. The fix is the same for all — move the reset into the `.then()` success handler:",
          "tool_uses": [
            {
              "id": "tooluse_0eTWFrG7KjLqprbPY7LOJO",
              "name": "execute_bash",
              "orig_name": "execute_bash",
              "args": {
                "command": "for f in \\\n  /home/obeej/Projects/speedplus/apps/admin/app/drivers/page.tsx \\\n  /home/obeej/Projects/speedplus/apps/admin/app/gas/merchants/page.tsx \\\n  /home/obeej/Projects/speedplus/apps/admin/app/gas/zones/page.tsx \\\n  /home/obeej/Projects/speedplus/apps/admin/app/merchants/page.tsx \\\n  /home/obeej/Projects/speedplus/apps/admin/app/orders/package/page.tsx; do\n  node -e \"\nconst fs = require('fs');\nlet c = fs.readFileSync('$f', 'utf8');\n// Pattern: useEffect(() => {\\n    setError('');\\n    adminApi.\n// Move setError('') into the .then() success callback\nc = c.replace(\n  /useEffect\\(\\(\\) => \\{\\n    setError\\(''\\);\\n    (adminApi\\.[^\\n]+)\\n      \\.then\\(([^)]+)\\) => \\{/g,\n  (m, call, param) => 'useEffect(() => {\\n    ' + call + '\\n      .then(' + param + ') => { setError(\\\\'\\\\');'\n);\nfs.writeFileSync('$f', c);\nconsole.log('fixed $f');\n\"\ndone"
